verses.text: Hadien ka jingïap u Saul, u Dabid u la wan phai na ka jingpynïap ïa ki Amalek bad u la sah ar sngi ha Ziklag.

Ha ka sngi ka balai, uwei u briew (ki jaiñphong jong u kiba la kad bad baroh shi khlieh da u khyndew suda) u la wan poi na jaka dara u Saul. Tang shu poi hakhmat u Dabid, u la dem haduh khyndew ban nguh ïa u.
U Dabid u la kylli ïa u, “Nangno phi wan ?” Te u la jubab ïa u, “Nga la her ïap na ka dara ki Israel.”
Nangta u Dabid u la kylli ïa u, “La jia kumno ? Ha ïathuh ïa nga.” Uta u la jubab, “Ki paid ki la phet na ka thma, bad bun bah ki la kyllon ïap; u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ruh ki la ïap.”
Te u Dabid u la kylli ïa uta u samla uba la wan ïathuh ïa u, “Kumno phi tip ba u Saul bad u khun jong u u Jonathan ki la ïap ?”
Uta u samla uba la wan ïathuh ïa u u la ong, “Nga la poi ryngkhat sha u Lum Gilboa, bad la don u Saul uba shaniah ha la u sum, ki kali thma bad ki shipai kulai pat de ki la don mar syndah jong u.
Te haba u la phai dien, u la ïohi ïa nga bad u la khot. Nga la thie, ‘Nga don hangne.’
U la ong ïa nga, ‘Phi dei uei ?’ Nga la ïathuh ïa u, ‘Nga dei u nong Amalek.’
Kumta u la ong ha nga, ‘Ale ïeng hajan jong nga bad to pynïap ïa nga. Namar nga shitom than eh, hynrei nga dang sah mynsiem.’

Kumta nga la leit ïeng hajan jong u bad nga la pynïap ïa u, namar nga la tip skhem ba un ym im shuh ynda u la kyllon khru. Nga la shim ïa ka pansngiat kaba ha ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka ksah kti kaba u deng ha ka ksangti, bad nga la wan rah ïa ki shane sha u kynrad jong nga.”
U Dabid u la shim ïa la ki jaiñ bad u la kad ïa ki, bad ki briew baroh kiba ïadon bad u ki la leh kumjuh.

Te ki la sngewsih bad ki la ïam, bad ki la shah jingit haduh ynda janmiet na ka bynta u Saul bad u khun jong u u Jonathan, na ka bynta ki paid u Trai bad ka ïing ka sem Israel, namar ki la kyllon da ka waitlam.
Te u Dabid u la kylli ïa uta u samla uba wan ïathuh ïa u, “Phi dei uba nangno ?” Uta u la jubab, “Nga dei u khun jong u mynder, u nong Amalek.”
Hangta u Dabid u la ong ha u, “Kumno ba phim tieng ban kner ïa la ka kti ban pynïap kat ïa u balapynsleh jong u Trai ?”
Kumta u Dabid u la khot ïa uwei na ki samla bad u la ong, “Shim pom ïa u.” Te uta u la pom ïa u ha ban da ïap.
Te u Dabid u la ong ha u, “Ka snam jong me halor ka khlieh jong me; ka shyntur jong me hi ka la sakhi pyrshah ïa me, haba me ong, ‘Nga la pynïap ïa u balapynsleh jong u Trai.’ ”
Nangta u Dabid u la rwai kynud ïa kane ka jingïam briew na ka bynta u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u.
La thoh ïa ka ha ka Kitab u Jashar, ban hikai ïa ka rongbiria ha ki khun Juda. U la rwai kumne:
Ani ! Ïa ka burom jong pha, ko Israel, la pynïap halor ki jaka kynjang ! Kumno ki bakhlaiñ bor ki la kyllon !
Hei wat leit ïathuh ha Gath, wat thad rong ha ki lynti syngkien ka Ashkelon; ïoh ki ’theisamla ki Philistia ki kyrkoh, ïoh ki khun kynthei jong ki bakhlem otsher ki ïarisa.
Phi ki lum ka Gilboa, ai ban ym don umjer ne slap halor jong phi, lymne jingkyrsoi um na bajylliew ! Naba halor jong phi ïa ka stieh jong u ’riewshlur la pynbit tngit.

Ïa ka stieh u Saul ym shym pynsleh da ka umphniang, hynrei da ka snam jong ki baïap, da ka khleiñ jong ki bakhlaiñ bor; ka ryntieh u Jonathan kam shym phai dien, lymne ka waitlam u Saul ka wan phai thylli.
U Saul bad u Jonathan, ki ba-ieid bad ki ba i ieid, khlem ïakhlad ha ka jingim bad ka jingïap ! Ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukni, ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki sing !
Ko khun kynthei ka Israel, to ïam namar u Saul, uba la pynkup ïa phi da ka linen bad ki jaiñ sawsyngiang, uba la pynriam da ki jyndeng ksiar halor ki jaiñphong jong phi.
Kumno ki bakhlaiñ bor ki la kyllon hapdeng ka jingïaleh ! U Jonathan u thiah ba shah pynïap halor ki jaka ki bakynjang.
Nga ïam na ka bynta jong phi, ko Jonathan, ko para jong nga, ko lok thep mynsiem jong nga ! Ka jingieid jong phi ïa nga ka kham phylla ban ïa ka jingieid jong ki kynthei.
Kumno ki bakhlaiñ bor ki la kyllon, bad ki tiar ïapom ki la pulom

Hadien kane u Dabid u la wad jingtip na u Trai, “Hato ngan leit kiew sha kano kano ka nongbah Juda ?” Te u Trai U la ong ha u, “Khie leit.” U Dabid u la kylli biang, “ Sha kano ngan leit kiew ?” Te U la ong, “Sha Hebron.”
Kumta u Dabid u la leit shata, ryngkat bad ki tnga jong u ar ngut, ka Ahinoam nong Jezreel, bad ka Abigail, ka tnga u Nabal nong Karmel uba la ïap.
U Dabid u la ïalam ïa ki briew kiba don bad u, uwei pa uwei bad la ka ïing ka sem, bad ki la shong shnong ha Hebron.
Te ki paid Juda ki la ïawan shata bad ki la pynsleh ïa u Dabid kum u syiem halor ka ïing u Juda. Haba ki la ïathuh ïa u Dabid, “Dei ki nong Jabesh-Gilead kiba la tep ïa u Saul,”

U Dabid u la phah ki nongrah khubor sha ki nong Jabesh-Gilead, bad u la ong ha ki, “To u Trai Un kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa phi, namar ba phi la pynpaw ïa la ka jingieid ïa u Saul, u kynrad jong phi, bad ba phi la tep ïa u !
To u Trai Un ieid sbun bad un pynneh kular bad phi ! Nga ruh ngan sa leh bha ïa phi namarba phi la leh ïa kane.
Mynta to long ki bashlur bad ki briew ki badohsnieh. U Saul u kynrad jong phi u la ïap, bad ka ïing u Juda ka la pynsleh ïa nga kum u syiem jong ki.”
Te u Abner u khun u Ner, u rangbah ki pyrton u Saul, u la shim ïa u Ishbosheth, u khun u Saul, bad u la ïalam ïa u sha Mahanaim.
U la pynlong syiem ïa u halor ka Gilead, halor ki nong Ashur, halor ki Jezreel, ki Ephraim, ki Benjamin bad ki Israel baroh.
U Ishbosheth, u khun u Saul, u la don sawphew snem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar halor ka Israel bad u la synshar ar snem. Hynrei ka ïing u Juda ka la bud ïa u Dabid.
Ka por ba u Dabid u la long syiem ha Hebron halor ka ïing u Juda ka la long hynñiew snem hynriew bnai.
U Abner, u khun u Ner, bad ki nongbud u Ishbosheth u khun u Saul, ki la leit na Mahanaim sha Gibeon.

U Joab u khun u Zeruïa u la mih bad ki nongbud u Dabid bad ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka pukri ha Gibeon. Hangta ki la ïashong, kiwei sha kawei ka liang jong ka pukri, kiwei pat sha kawei pat ka liang jong kata ka pukri.
Te u Abner u la ong ha u Joab, “To ki samla kin ïaïeng ban ïaleh hakhmat jong ngi.” Te u Joab u la ong, “Ai kin ïaïeng.”
Te ki la ïamih bad la ñiew ïa ki, khat-ar ngut na ki Benjamin ki jong u Ishbosheth u khun u Saul, bad khat-ar ngut na ki nongbud u Dabid.
Te uwei u la kem ïa ka khlieh uwei pat bad u la tynrah artat da ka waitlam na krung jong u, kumta ki la ïakyllon lang baroh. Namarkata ïa kata ka jaka, kaba ha Gibeon, la khot ka Lyngkha ki waitlam.
Ka jingïaleh ha kata ka sngi ka la long ka bashyrkhei shibun, hynrei u Abner bad ki paid Israel ki la shah rem ha ki nongbud u Dabid.
Ki khun u Zeruïa baroh lai ngut, u Joab, u Abishai, bad u Asahel, ki la ïadon hangta. U Asahel u la long u bastet mareh la kum ka skei ha khlaw.
Te u Asahel u la beh nadien ïa u Abner, bad haba u beh um phai sha kamon ne sha kadiang bad u la bud sia ïa u Abner.
Kumta u Abner u la kyrtiang bad u la ong, “Dei ma me, Asahel ?” Une u la jubab, “Dei ma nga.”
U Abner u la ong ha u, “Phai sha kamon ne sha kadiang jong me, kynrup ïa uno uno u samla bad knieh baroh katba ïoh na u.” Hynrei u Asahel um treh ieh noh ban bud ïa u.

Hangta u Abner u la ong biang ha u Asahel, “Keiñ noh ban beh ïa nga; balei nga dei ban pom ïa me haduh ba men da kyllon ha khyndew ? Ynda kumta kumno ngan dang nud peit ïa ka khmat u hynmen jong me u Joab ?”

La katta ruh um treh satia ban keiñ noh. Kumta u Abner u la tynrah na ka kpoh da ka tdong u sum jong u haduh ba u sum u da pei phlait ha ingdong. U la kyllon hangta bad u la ïap ha shen. Te kat kiba wan poi sha kata ka jaka ha kaba u Asahel u la kyllon bad u la ïap, ki la sangeh.
Hynrei u Joab bad u Abishai ki ïaibeh nadien ïa u Abner, bad haba lajan sep ka sngi ki la poi sha u lum ha Amma uba don hakhmat Gia ha ka lynti kaba leit sha ri kynjah ka Gibeon.
Te ki Benjamin ki la ïalum lang nadien u Abner, la kum shi kynhun, bad ki la ïeng ha kliar uwei u lum.

Te u Abner u la pyrta ïa u Jaob, “Dei ma ba ka waitlam kan bam duh shi junom ? Hato phim tip mo ba ka bakut kan long ka bakthang ? Lano phin ai hukum ïa la ki paid ba kin ym beh shuh ïa la ki hynmen ki para ?”
Nangta u Joab u la ong, “Kumba u Blei U im, lada phim shym la kren, kine ki paid kin ym ieh noh ban beh ïa la ki hynmen para haduh mynstep.”
Kumta u Joab u la put ïa ka turoi; baroh ki paid ki la sangeh bad kim beh shuh ïa ki Israel, lymne ïaleh thma shuh.
U Abner bad ki pyrton jong u ki la ïaïaid baroh shi miet lyngba ka Araba, nangta ki la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ki la ïaid baroh shi step haduh ban da poi ha Mahanaim.
U Joab u la lah wan phai na ka jingbeh ïa u Abner; haba u la lum lang ïa ki paid baroh, la jah khatkhyndai ngut na ki nongbud u Dabid nalor u Asahel.
Hynrei ki nongbud u Dabid ki la pynïap lai spah hynriewphew ngut ki Benjamin, ki briew u Abner.

Nangta ki la shim ïa u Asahel, bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka jyntep u kpa jong u kaba ha Bethlehem. U Joab bad ki briew jong u ki la ïaïaid baroh shi miet, bad ka sngi ka la kynjat jingshai mar ïapoi ha Hebron.
La don ka thma ka baslem hapdeng ka ïing u Saul bad ka ïing u Dabid; hynrei ka ïing u Dabid ka la nangkhlaiñ, katba ka ïing u Saul pat de ka la nangtlot bor tlot bor.
Ki khun ba la kha ha u Dabid ha Hebron ki dei: u Amnon, u khun phrangsngi jong u, na ka Ahinoam nong Jezreel,
u Shileab, u ba-ar, na ka Abigail ka tnga u Nabal nong Karmel; u Absalom, u balai, na ka Maaka ka khun u Talmai u syiem Geshur;
u Adonija, u basaw, na ka Haggith; u Shephatia, u basan, u khun ka Abital;
bad u Ithream, u bahynriew, na ka Egla, ka tnga u Dabid. Ïa kine ki khun la kha ha u Dabid ha Hebron.
Katba dang don ka thma hapdeng ka ïing u Saul bad ka ïing u Dabid, u Abner pat u nangpynkhlaiñ bor ïa lade ha ka ïing u Saul.
U Saul u la don ka tnga kliar, kaba kyrteng ka Rizpa, ka khun u Aïa, bad u Ishbosheth u la ong ha u Abner, “Balei phi leit ïashong bad ka tnga kliar u kpa jong nga ?”

Hangta u Abner u la bitar tyngeh ïa ki ktien u Ishbosheth, u ong artat, “Hato nga dei ka khlieh ksew ha ri Juda ? Haduh mynta nga leh sbun ïa ka ïing u kpa jong me u Saul, ïa ki hynmen para jong u, wat ïa ki lok jong u, bad ngam shym la ieh noh ïa me ha ki kti u Dabid. Pynban me kynnoh sniew ïa nga mynta ka sngi bad ka kynthei.
To u Blei Un leh kumta bad pyntam ruh ïa u Abner, lada ngam pyndep na ka bynta u Dabid ïa kata kaba u Trai U la smai ha u,
ban pynkynriah ïa ka hima na ka ïing u Saul, bad ban seng ïa ka khet u Dabid halor ka Israel bad ka Juda, naduh Dan haduh Beersheba.”
U Ishbosheth um shym lait ang shuh wat shi kyntien namar ba u tieng ïa u.

Te u Abner u la phah ki nongrah khubor sha u Dabid ha Hebron, u ong, “Ka ri ka dei ka jongno ? To ïateh jutang noh bad nga, bad ka kti jong nga kan don ryngkat bad phi ban ïalam ïa ka Israel baroh hapoh jong phi.”

Une u la ong, “Ka babha; nga mon ban ïateh jutang bad phi, hynrei nga dang kwah ban ïoh kawei kaei kaei na phi. Kata ka long, phin ym ïohi ïa ka khmat jong nga lymda phi wanlam nyngkong ïa ka Mikhal, ka khun u Saul, haba phin wan ïakynduh bad nga.”
Hadien kata u Dabid u la phah ki nongrah khubor sha u Ishbosheth u khun u Saul, u ong, “Ai noh ïa ka tnga jong nga, ka Mikhal, ïa kaba nga la siew dor da ki shispah ’niehduh ki Philistia.”
U Ishbosheth u la phah ïa ka, bad u la knieh noh ïa ka na u tnga jong ka u Paltiel, u khun u Laish.
Hynrei u tnga jong ka u la leit on ïa ka, u ïam shilynter ka lynti nadien jong ka haduh Bahunrim. Te u Abner u la ong ha u, “Khie, leit noh,” bad u la leit phai.
U Abner u la ïashong pyrkhat bad ki tymmen ki san ka Israel, u ong, “La kham katto katne mynshuwa phi la ïawad ïa u Dabid ba un long syiem ïa phi.
To leh noh mynta, namar u Trai U la kular ha u Dabid, U ong, ‘Da ka kti u shakri jong Nga u Dabid Ngan pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel na ka kti ki Philistia bad ki nongshun jong ki baroh.’ ”
U Abner u la leit kren sa ha ki Benjamin, nadien kata u la leit ïathuh ïa u Dabid ha Hebron ïa kaei ba ka Israel bad ka jait Benjamin baroh kawei ki la sngewdei ban leh.
Haba u Abner u la wan lang bad arphew ngut ki briew sha u Dabid ha Hebron, u Dabid u la pynlong ka jynkhawai na ka bynta u Abner bad ki briew kiba don bad u.

Te u Abner u la ong ha u Dabid, “Shuh ngan leit noh kloi ba ngan ïoh khot lang ïa ki Israel baroh sha u syiem kynrad jong nga, ba kin dup ïateh jutang bad phi, bad phin dup ïoh synshar halor kiei kiei katba kwah ka dohnud jong phi.” Kumta u Dabid u la phah noh ïa u Abner khlem pynsatia ei ei ïa u.

Markumta la wan poi ki nongbud u Dabid ryngkat bad u Joab na ka jingleit lute, ki la wan rah bad ki shikatdei ka mar kliarwait. Hynrei u Abner um don shuh bad u Dabid ha Hebron, namar une u la phah leit suk leit saiñ ïa u.
Haba u Joab bad ki pyrton kiba ïaleit bad u ki la wan poi, ki la ïathuh ïa u, “U Abner khun u Ner u la wan sha u syiem bad une u la shah ïa u ban leit suk leit saiñ.”
Hangta u Joab u la leit sha u syiem, bad u la ong, “Phi leh lei kumne ? Hana u Abner u la wan sha phi, te balei phi la phah noh ïa u ban leit phai suk ?
Phi tip ba u Abner u la wan ban thok ïa phi bad ban dup tip ïa ka leit ka wan jong phi bad ïa ki kam ki jam jong phi.”
Ynda u Joab u la mih nakhmat u Dabid, u la phah briew ban leit wad ïa u Abner, bad ki la wan ïalam ïa u na ka pukri ha Sira; hynrei u Dabid u khlem da tip ei ei ïa kata.

Te haba u Abner u la wan phai sha Hebron, u Joab u la ïalam ïa u sha khyrdop kum ban ïakren jar jar tang bad u, bad u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh haduh ba un da ïap, na ka bynta ka snam u Asahel u para jong u.
Ynda hadien habud u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata, u la ong, “Ma nga bad ka hima jong nga ngim kit pop da lei lei hakhmat u Trai na ka bynta ka snam u Abner khun u Ner.

Ieh kan hap halor ka khlieh u Joab bad halor ka ïing ka sem u kpa jong u. Ai ba ha ka ïing ka sem u Joab yn ym duh uban pang liat ksuit, ne pang ñianglyngkut, ne uba shan deingduh, ne uba ïap tyrut, ne uba khlem kpu !”
Dei u Joab bad u Abishai baroh shipara kiba la pynïap ïa u Abner, namarba une u la pynïap ïa u para jong ki u Asahel ha ka thma Gibeon.
Te u Dabid u la ong ha u Joab bad ki briew kiba don bad u, “Kad ïa la ki jaiñ, pien da ki jaiñ khaiñ, bad ïam hakhmat u Abner.” U Syiem Dabid u la bud ïa ka krong.
Ki la tep ïa u Abner ha Hebron, te u syiem u la kyang bad u la ïam ha ka jyntep u Abner. Ki paid baroh ruh ki la ïaïam.
Bad u syiem u la rwai ka jingrwai ïam briew, “Dei sha ba u Abner un ïap kumba ïap u biej ?
Ïa ki kti jong phi ym shym la khum, ïa ki kjat jong phi ym shym la pyndait nar. Kumba kyllon hakhmat ki ’riewdakaid, ma phi phi la kyllon.” Bad baroh u paid u la ïam biang na ka bynta jong u.

Te ki paidbah baroh ki la wan ban pynkohnguh ïa u Dabid ban bam kpu katba dang don sngi, hynrei u Dabid u la smai, u da ong, “To u Blei Un leh kumta bad kham palat ruh lada nga mad kpu ne jynbam ei ei katba ym pat sep ka sngi !”
Baroh ki paidbah ki la sngewthuh ïa kane bad ki la sngewbha, namar kat kaba u syiem u la leh ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki baroh.
Kumta baroh ki paidbah bad ki Israel ki la sngewthuh ha kata ka sngi ba ym shym dei satia ka mon u syiem ban pynïap ïa u Abner, u khun u Ner.
Te u syiem u la ong ha ki nongbud jong u, “Phim tip mo ba u kynja syiem bad u ’riewkhraw u la kyllon mynta ka sngi ha Israel ?

Nga tlot mynta ka sngi wat la nga long u syiem balapynsleh. Kine ki briew ki khun u Zeruïa, ki long ki badohsnieh than na ka bynta jong nga. Ieh u Trai Un ai bainong ïa u nongkam sniew katkum ka kam dakaid jong u !”
Haba u Ishbosheth, u khun u Saul, u la ïohsngew ba u Abner u la ïap ha Hebron, u la tlor ka mynsiem, bad ki Israel baroh ki la sheptieng her.

Une u khun jong u Saul u la don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba long ki nongïalam jong ki kynhun lute; uwei u kyrteng u Baana, uwei pat u kyrteng Rekhab, ki khun u Rimmon u jait Benjamin na Beeroth (namar ïa ka Beeroth la kheiñ bad ki Benjamin;
ki nong Beeroth ki la phet sha Gittaim bad ki la sah kum ki nongwei hangta haduh kane ka sngi).

U Jonathan, u khun u Saul, u la don uwei u khun uba dkoh ki kjat. U la don san snem ka ryta haba la poi khubor shaphang u Saul bad u Jonathan na Jezreel; ka nongsumar jong u ka la shim ïa u bad ka la phet, hynrei katba ka dang phet kyrkieh, u la hap bad u sa kylla dkhoh. Ka kyrteng jong u u Mephibosheth.
Te ki khun u Rimmon nong Beeroth, u Rekhab bad u Baana, ki la mih hamar ba la shit kyrang ka sngi bad ki la wan poi sha ïing u Ishbosheth, katba u dang thiah mynsngi.
Ka nongap jynkhang jong ka ïing kaba pynkhuid kew, ka la shoh samthiah bad ka la ïohthiah. Kumta u Rekhab bad u Baana u para jong u ki la rung sor hapoh ïing.
Haba ki la rung hapoh ïing, katba u dang thiah ha kamra thiah, ki la pom ïa u haban da ïap bad ki la khrai khlieh ïa u. Ki la shim ïa ka khlieh jong u, bad ki la ïaid baroh shimiet na lynti Araba,

bad ki la wan rah ïa ka khlieh u Ishbosheth sha u Dabid ha Hebron. Ki la ong ha u syiem, “Heh kane ka khlieh u Ishbosheth, u khun u Saul, u nongshun jong phi, uba la thap ïa ka jingim jong phi. U Trai U la pynïoh kput ïa u kynrad syiem jong nga mynta ka sngi halor u Saul bad u khun jong u.”
Hynrei u Dabid u la jubab ïa u Rekhab bad u Baana u para jong u, ki khun u Rimmon nong Beeroth, “Kumba u Trai U im, ma U Uba la siewspah ïa ka jingim jong nga na ki jingshipa baroh,

mynba uwei u la wan ïathuh ïa nga, ‘Hakhmih u Saul u la ïap’ bad u tharai ba u la wan rah ka khubor babha, nga la shim ïa u bad nga la pynïap ïa u ha Ziklag, kum ka bainong ba nga ai ïa u na ka bynta ka khubor jong u.

Katno lei lei haba ki ’riewdakaid ki la pynïap ïa u briew u bahok ha ïing lajong haba u dang thiah, hato ngan ym dawa ïa ka snam jong u na ki kti jong phi, bad ngan ym pynduh pyndam ïa phi na ka khyndew ?”

Kumta u Dabid u la ai hukum ïa ki samla jong u bad ki la pynïap ïa ki, ki la pom ïa ki bad kti bad kjat, nangta ki sa sdien ïa ki hajan ka pung ha Hebron. Hynrei ki la shim ïa ka khlieh u Ishbosheth bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jyntep u Abner ha Hebron.
Kumta ki jait Israel baroh ki la wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron bad ki la ong, “Hakhmih, ngi dei kajuh ka doh ka shyieng bad phi.

Ha ki por bamynshuwa, mynba u Saul u la long u syiem jong ngi, dei ma phi uba la ïalam bad la pynphai biang ïa ki Israel, bad u Trai U la ong ha phi, ‘Phin sa long u nongsharai jong ki paid jong Nga, ki Israel, bad phin sa long u syiem halor ki Israel.’ ”

Kumta ki tymmen ki san baroh jong ka Israel ki la wan sha u syiem ha Hebron, bad u syiem Dabid u la ïateh jutang bad ki ha Hebron hakhmat u Trai, bad nangta ki la pynsleh ïa u Dabid kum u syiem ka Israel.
U Dabid u la don laiphewsnem ka ryta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar sawphew snem.
Ha Hebron u la synshar ïa ka Juda hynñiew snem hynriew bnai, bad ha Jerusalem u la synshar ïa ka Israel bad ka Juda laiphewlai snem.

U syiem bad ki nongbud jong u ki la hiar thma ïa ka Jerusalem pyrshah ki Jebus, ki trai shnong kata ka ri, kiba la kob ha u Dabid, “Phin ym ïoh rung hangne. Wat ki matlah bad ki dkoh kin pynher krad ïa phi !” —ki tharai ba u Dabid un ym ïoh rung hangta.
Pynban u Dabid u la ïoh knieh ïa ka kut Zion, kata ka mut, ka Nongbah u Dabid.

Ha kata ka sngi u Dabid u la ong, “Jar uban pom ïa ki Jebus, bad un leit kiew da ka nur um ban ïaleh ïa ki badkoh bad ki bamatlah kiba shun ïa u Dabid…” Nangta la mih ka jingong, “Ki dkoh bad ki matlah kin ym rung ha ka ïing syiem.”
U Dabid u la leit ban shong ha ka kut bad u la khot ïa ka ka Nongbah u Dabid. U Dabid u la tei kynroh sawdong jong ka na ka Millo shapoh.
Kumta u Dabid u la nangkhraw nangkhraw, namar u Trai, u Blei ki paid, U don bad u.
U Hiram syiem Tirus u la phah ki nongrah ktien syiem sha u Dabid lem bad ki dieng kedar, nangta sa ki misteri dieng bad ki misteri maw kiba la tei ïa ka ïing u Dabid.
U Dabid u la ïohi ba u Trai U la pynskhem syiem ïa u halor ki Israel bad ba U la kyntiew burom ïa ka jinglong syiem jong u na ka bynta ki paid jong U ki Israel.
U Dabid u la shim tnga kliar bad tnga trai shuh shuh na Jerusalem, hadien ba u la wan na Hebron, te kumta la nangbun ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei ba la kha ha u Dabid.
Ki kyrteng jong kito ïa kiba la kha ha u ha Jerusalem ki la long: u Shammuwa, u Shobab, u Nathan, bad u Solomon,
u Ibhar, u Elishuwa, u Nephek, bad u Japhia,
u Elishama, u Eliada, bad u Eliphelet.
Haba ki Philistia ki la ïohsngew ba ïa u Dabid la pynsleh ban long syiem halor ki Israel, baroh ki Philistia ki la leit wad ïa u Dabid. Tang shu ïohsngew ïa kata, u Dabid u la leit hiar sha ka kut.
Mynta ki Philistia ki la saphriang kylleng ka them Rephaim.

U Dabid u la wad jingtip na u Trai, “Hato ngan ïeng ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Hato Men aiti ïa ki ha ka kti jong nga ?” Te u Trai U la ong ha u Dabid, “Khie leit. Ngan ai khlem artatien ïa ki Philistia ha ka kti jong phi.”

U Dabid u la wan sha Baal-perasim bad u la jop ïa ki hangta. Nangta u la ong, “U Trai U la pynlwet ïa ki nongshun jong nga la kum da ka jingshlei um kaba lynshop.” Namarkata ïa kata ka jaka la khot kyrteng Baal-perasim.
Ki Philistia ki la ieh noh ïa la ki bleithaw hangta, bad u Dabid ryngkat bad ki nongbud jong u ki la rong noh ïa ki baroh.
Te ki Philistia ki la wan biang bad ki la saphriang kylleng ka them Rephaim.
Haba u Dabid u la wad jingtip, u Trai U la ong, “Phim dei ban leit kiew. Leit sawdong nadien jong ki, bad kynrup ïa ki haba la poi mar pyrshah ki dieng mastik.
Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaid ha kliar ki dieng mastik, tur shaphrang, namar u Trai U la leit shakhmat jong phi ban pom ïa u pyrton ki Philistia.”
Te u Dabid u la leh kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u, bad u la pom ïa ki Philistia naduh Gibeon haduh Gezer.
Te u Dabid u la ïalum lang ïa ki ’rangkynsai baroh jong ka Israel, laiphewhajar ngut.
U Dabid u la mih ryngkat bad ki briew jong u baroh na Baale-juda, ban wan rah nangta ïa ka synduk u Blei, kaba ïoh kyrteng na u Trai ki paid Uba shong halor ki kherub.
Ki la rah ïa ka synduk u Blei ha ka kali ka bathymmai, bad ki la sei ïa ka na ka ïing u Abinadab kaba don halor lum. U Ussa bad u Ahio, ki khun u Abinadab, ki la ïalam ïa ka kali bathymmai
kaba don ïa ka synduk u Blei, u Ahio pat u shu ïaid hakhmat ka synduk.
U Dabid bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïaleh kmen hakhmat u Trai katba kot la ka bor da ki jingrwai, ki duitara bad ki kanjari, da ki ksing ki dhah, ki shakuriaw bad ki Shalymmen.
Haba ki la poi sha ka kyntem u Nakon, u Ussa u la kner ïa la ka kti sha ka synduk u Blei bad u la bat ïa ka, namar ki masi ki la jynthut.
Ka jingbitar u Trai; ka la khie ir pyrshah u Ussa, bad u Blei U la shohïap ïa u hangta namar ba u la ktah ruma ïa ka synduk. U la ïap ha shen ha syndah ka synduk u Blei.
U Dabid u la sngewsih namarba u Trai U la leh bitar ïa u Ussa, bad ïa kata ka jaka la khot Peres-ussa haduh kane ka sngi.
U Dabid u la tieng ïa u Trai ha kata ka sngi, bad u la ong, “Kumno keiñ ka synduk u Trai ka lah ban wan sha nga ?”
Kumta u Dabid um treh ban rah ïa ka synduk u Trai sha ka nongbah u Dabid, hynrei u la pynphai ïa ka sha ka ïing u Obed-Edom u nong Gath.
Te ka synduk u Trai ka la sah ha ïing u Obed-Edom nong Gath lai bnai, bad u Trai U la kyrkhu ïa u Obed-Edom bad ïa ka ïing ka sem jong u baroh.

La leit ïathuh ïa u Syiem Dabid, “U Trai U la kyrkhu ïa ka ïing ka sem u Obed-Edom, bad ïa kiei kiei baroh ki jong u, na ka daw ka synduk u Blei.” Kumta u Dabid u la leit rah noh ïa ka synduk u Blei na ïing u Obed-Edom sha ka nongbah u Dabid da ka jingleh kmen.
Haba kito kiba bah ïa ka synduk u Trai ki la ïaid hynriew sien jam, u la kñia u masi bad u ’langbrot lud u basngaid.
U Dabid u la shad hakhmat u Trai katba u nang, bad u la panpoh da ka ephod linen.
Kumta u Dabid bad ka ïing Israel baroh kawei ki la wan rah ïa ka synduk u Trai da ka jingrisa bad ka jingsawa ka ronsing.

Katba ka synduk u Trai ka wan rung ha ka nongbah u Dabid, ka Mikhal, ka khun u Saul, ka la peit na ka jynkhang ïit bad ka la ïohi ïa u Dabid ba u kynthih bad u shad hakhmat u Trai, bad ka la beiñ ïa u ha la ka dohnud.

Te ki la pynrung ïa ka synduk u Trai bad ki la buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka, hapoh ka ïing jaiñ kaba u Dabid u la pynïeng na ka bynta jong ka. Nangta u Dabid u la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang bad ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat hakhmat u Trai.
Haba u Dabid u la dep ban tyrwa ïa ki jynkñia thang bad ki jynkñia ïabha ïamiat u la kyrkhu ïa ki paidbah ha ka kyrteng u Trai ki paid,

bad u la sam ïa ki briew baroh shi paid Israel, shynrang bad kynthei, mar shi nuid u kpu, mar shi bhah ka doh, bad mar shi tukra u soh khajur. Nangta u paidbah baroh u la leit phai sha la ïing la ïing.

U Dabid ruh u la leit phai ban kyrkhu ïa la ka ïing ka sem. Hynrei ka Mikhal, ka khun u Saul, ka la mih shabar ban ïakynduh ïa u Dabid, bad ka la ong, “Kumno u syiem Israel u la burom ïa lade mynta ka sngi, haba u pynlymbuit ïa lade hakhmat ki shakri kynthei jong ki nongbud jong u, la kumba pynpaw khlem akor u kynja ’riewpoh !”

Te u Dabid u la ong ha ka Mikhal, “Dei hakhmat u Trai, Uba la jied ïa nga ban ïa u kpa jong pha bad ka ïing ka sem jong u baroh kawei haba U la thung ïa nga ban long u syiem ki Israel, ki paid u Trai—bad nga dei ban leh kmen hakhmat u Trai.
Ngan dang kham pynpoh shuh shuh ïa lade ban ïa kane, bad ngan sa shah ibeiñ ha pha hynrei ngan sa ïoh burom na ki shakri kynthei kiba pha la kren beiñ.”
Ka Mikhal, ka khun u Saul, kam shym ïoh khun haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong ka.
Mynta haba u syiem u la shong ha ïing lajong, bad u Trai U la ai jingsuk ïa u na ki nongshun jong u kylleng sawdong,
u syiem u la ong ha u Nathan nongïathuhlypa, “Ha peit seh, nga nga shong ha ka ïing dieng kedar, hynrei ka synduk u Blei ka shong ha ka ïing jaiñ.”
Te u Nathan u la ong ha u syiem, “Khie, leh katba don ha ka jingmut jong phi, namar u Trai U don lem bad phi.”
La jia ba ha kata hi ka miet ka ktien u Trai ka la poi ha u Nathan,
“Khie ïathuh ïa u shakri jong Nga, u Dabid, ‘Kumne u Trai U ong: Hato phin tei kawei ka ïing ba Ngan shong ?
Ngam shym la shong ïing kedar haduh mynta, naduh ka sngi ba Nga la sei ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt, hynrei Nga la shong ha ka ïing jaiñ kylleng kylleng.

Ha ki jaka baroh kiba Nga la ïaid bad ki paid Israel, hato Nga la ju ong ha uno uno na ki nongbishar, kiba Nga la buh ban sharai ïa u paid Israel jong Nga: Balei sha phim shym tei kawei ka ïing kedar na ka bynta jong Nga ?”

“Mynta namarkata phin leit ong kumne ha u shakri jong Nga u Dabid, ‘U Trai ki paid U ong kumne: Nga la shim ïa phi na ka jaka bamphlang, na ka jingsharai blang, ba phin dup long u syiem halor ki paid jong Nga ki Israel;

Nga la don lem bad phi kat shaba phi leit, bad Nga la pom ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh nakhmat jong phi. Te Ngan sa pynkhraw ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kat ka kyrteng jong ki briew ki bakhraw jong ka khyndew.

Ngan sa pynthikna kawei ka jaka na ka bynta ki paid jong Nga ki Israel, bad Ngan sa buh ïa ki hangta ba kin dup shong ha la ka jaka, bad ba yn ym don ba pynsatia shuh ïa ki, te kumta ki ’riewdakaid kin ym pynjynjar shuh ïa ki kum mynshuwa,

kum naduh ka por ba Nga la buh ïa ki nongbishar halor ki paid jong Nga ki Israel; bad Ngan sa ai jingsuk ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi. Nalor kata u Trai U kular ba Un sa pynlong ïa phi ka kur syiem.
Ynda ki sngi jong phi ki la kut bad phi la thiah bad ki kpa jong phi, Ngan sa kyntiew sa ïa u khun jong phi, uban sa mih na ka met jong phi, bad Ngan sa pynskhem ïa ka hima jong u.
Une un sa tei kawei ka ïing ha ka kyrteng jong Nga, bad Ngan sa pynskhem ïa ka khet jong ka jinglong syiem jong u shi junom.
Ngan sa long u kpa jong u bad un sa long u khun jong Nga. Lada u leh kam bymman, Ngan sa sympat ïa u da u diengduh kumba leh ki briew, da ki jingkawut kumba ju leh ki briew.
Hynrei Ngan ym weng noh ïa ka jingieid sbun jong Nga na u, kumba Nga la weng noh na u Saul ïa uba Nga la pynkynriah nakhmat jong phi.
Ïa ka ïing jong phi bad ka jinglong syiem jong phi yn sa pynskhem shi junom hakhmat jong Nga; ïa ka khet jong phi yn sa pynneh shi junom.’ ”
U Nathan u la kren ha u Dabid ïa kitei ki ktien baroh katkum ka jingïohipaw.
Te u Dabid u la leit rung bad u la shong hakhmat u Trai, u ong, “Uei ma nga, a Trai ko Blei, bad kaei ka ïing jong nga ba Me la ïalam ïa nga haduh katne ?

Pynban kane ka la long kaei kaei ka barit ha ki khmat jong Me, a Trai ko Blei. Me la kren ruh shaphang ka ïing u shakri jong Me na ka bynta ka lawei ka bajlan, bad Me la pyni ha nga ïa ki pateng bynriew ki ban sa wan, a Trai ko Blei.
Te aïu shuh u Dabid un nang ban ong ha Me ? Naba Me tip ïa u shakri jong Me, a Trai ko Blei !
Kumba Me la kular, bad katkum ka dohnud jong Me, Me la pynpaw ïa kane kaei kaei ka bakhraw ba u shakri jong Me un dup tip ïa ka.
Namarkata, Me long u bakhraw, a Trai ko Blei. Ym don mano mano kum ma Me, bad ym don Blei nalor jong Me, kat kumba ngi la ïohsngew da ki shkor jong ngi.

Hato don jait bynriew kawei pat ha khyndew kaba kum u paid Israel jong Me, ïa uba da u Blei hi la siewspah ban long u paid jong U, kat ban pynpaw nam ïa lade da kaba leh ïa kiei kiei ki bakhraw bad ki bashyrkhei na ka bynta jong ki, da kaba pynher krad ïa ki jait bynriew bad ïa ki blei jong ki nakhmat ki paid jong U, ïa kiba Me la pyllait na ka bynta ïa lade na ri Ijipt ?
Me la pynskhem ïa u paid Israel jong Me na ka bynta ïa lade ba un dup long u paid jong Me shi junom; bad Me, ko Trai, Me la kylla long u Blei jong ki.
Te mynta, a Trai ko Blei, to pynskhem junom bhor ïa ka ktien ba Me la kren shaphang u shakri jong Me bad shaphang ka ïing ka sem jong u, bad to leh kumba Me la kren.
Hangta ïa ka kyrteng jong Me yn sa pynkhraw junom, da kaba ong, ‘U Trai ki paid U long u Blei halor ka Israel,’ bad ïa ka ïing ka sem u shakri jong Me u Dabid yn sa pynskhem hakhmat jong Me.

Naba ma Me, ko Trai ki paid, ko Blei ka Israel, Me la pynpaw ïa kane ha u shakri jong Me, da kaba ong, ‘Ngan sa pynlong kawei ka kur syiem na ka bynta jong phi.’ Na kane ka daw u shakri jong Me u la ïoh jingshlur ban duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai ha Me.
Te mynta, ko Trai ko Blei, Me long u Blei da shisha, bad ki ktien jong Me ki long ki bashisha bad Me la kular ïa kane kaei kaei ka babha ha u shakri jong Me.

To sngewbha namarkata ban kyrkhu mynta ïa ka ïing u shakri jong Me ba kan dup ïaid barabor hakhmat jong Me; naba ma Me, ko Trai ko Blei, Me la kren, bad da ka jingkyrkhu jong Me ka ïing u shakri jong Me kan long kaba la kyrkhu junom.”
Hadien kane u Dabid u la jop ïa ki Philistia bad u la ïuh roit ïa ki, nangta u Dabid u la knieh ïa ka Methekamma na ka kti ki Philistia.

U la jop ruh ïa ki Moab, bad u la thew ïa ki da ki laiñ, da kaba pynthiah pyllup ïa ki ha madan. Ar laiñ na ki dei ban pynïap, shilaiñ dei ban pynsah. Ki Moab ki la kylla ki raïot u Dabid bad ki la siew khajna.
U Dabid u la jop ruh ïa u Hadadezer u khun u Rehob u syiem Zoba, mynba u leit ban pynskhem biang ïa la ka bor ha ka wah Ïuphratis.

U Dabid u la kem koidi shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki pyrton shongkulai jong u, bad arphew hajar ngut ki pyrton ïaid kjat. U Dabid u la ot ïa ki thied khohwah jong ki kulai ring kali baroh, hynrei u la pynsah tang kat ban biang na ka bynta shispah tylli ki kali.
Haba ki Siria na Damaskus ki la wan ïarap ïa u Hadadezer, syiem Zoba, u Dabid u la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki Siria.
Nangta u Dabid u la buh ki karod ha Aram jong ka Damaskus; kumta ki Siria ki la kylla ki raïot jong u Dabid bad ki la siew khajna. U Trai U la ai jingjop ïa u kat shaba u leit.
U Dabid u la knieh ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba rah ki nongbud u Hadadezer bad u la wan rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem.
Na Beta bad na Berothai, ki nongbah jong u Hadadezer, u syiem Dabid u la ïoh knieh shikatdei bah ka rnong.
Haba u Toi, u syiem Hamath, u la ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa u pyrton shipai baroh kawei jong u Hadadezer,

u la phah ïa la u khun, u Joram, ban ai khublei bad ban ai burom ïa u Dabid, namarba u la ïaleh ïa u Hadadezer bad u la jop ïa u, namar u Hadadezer u la ju ïaleh thma bad u Toi. Te u Joram u la wan rah bad u ki tiar rupa, tiar ksiar bad tiar rnong.
U syiem Dabid u la pynkyntang ïa kine ruh ha u Trai ryngkat bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u la knieh na ki jait bynriew ba u la jop,
ki Edom, ki Moab, ki Ammon, ki Philistia, ki Amalek, bad na ka mar kliarwait jong u Hadadezer u khun u Rehob, u syiem Zoba.
U Dabid u la ïoh nam ïa lade. Haba u la wan phai u la pynïap khatphra hajar ki Edom ha ka Them Mluh.
U la buh ki karod ha Edom; kylleng ka Edom u la buh ki karod, bad ki Edom baroh ki la kylla ki raïot u Dabid. Te u Trai U la ai jingjop ïa u Dabid kat shaba u leit.
U Dabid u la synshar halor ka Israel baroh. U Dabid u la pynïaid ïa ka jingsynshar da ka hok bad ka jingleh beit ïa u paid jong u baroh.
U Joab, u khun u Zeruïa, u la long u rangbah duh ki pyrton, bad u Jehoshaphat, u khun u Ahilud, u la long u nong sumar dulir.
U Zadok, khun u Ahitub, bad u Ahimelek, khun u Abiathar, ki la long ki lyngdoh, katba u Seraïa u la long u nongthoh.
U Benaïa, khun u Jehoïada, u la long halor ki Kereth bad ki Peleth, bad ki khun u Dabid ki la long ki lyngdoh.
Te u Dabid u la ong, “Hato dang don shuh mano mano uba sah na ka ïing u Saul ba ngan dup leh sbun ïa u na ka bynta u Jonathan ?”

La don uwei u shakri na ka ïing ka sem u Saul, uba kyrteng u Ziba, bad ki la phah leit ïa une sha u Dabid, bad u syiem u la ong ha u, “Hato phi dei u Ziba ?” Une u la jubab, “Hooid, u shakri jong phi.”
Kumta u syiem u la ong, “Hato dang don mano mano na ka ïing ka sem u Saul, ba ngan dup pynpaw ïa ka jingsbun u Blei ha u ?” U Ziba u la jubab ïa u syiem, “Dang don u khun u Jonathan; u dkoh ki kjat.”
U syiem u la ong ha u, “Haei u don ?” U Ziba u la jubab ïa u syiem, “U don ha ïing u Makhir, u khun u Ammiel, ha Lodebar.”
Te u syiem u la phah wan rah ïa u na ïing u Makhir, khun u Ammiel, ha Lodebar.
U Mephibosheth, u khun u Jonathan, u khun u Saul, u la wan sha u Dabid, u la dem ngon bad u la nguh la dem. Te u Dabid u la ong, “Ko Mephibosheth !” Uta u la jubab, “Hangne u shakri jong phi.”

U Dabid u la ong ha u, “Wat tieng, naba ngan sa leh sbun ïa phi na ka bynta u kpa jong phi u Jonathan. Ngan sa pynïoh biang ha phi baroh ka khyndew ka shyiap u Saul u kpa jong phi, bad phin sa bam ha ka miej jong nga barabor.”
Uta u la nguh la dem bad u la ong, “Uei eh u shakri jong phi ba phi dei ban da ñiewkor ïa u ksew baïap kum ma nga ?”
Te u syiem u la khot ïa u Ziba, u shakri u Saul, bad u la ong ha u, “Baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul bad jong ka ïing ka sem jong u baroh nga la ai ha u khun jong u kynrad jong phi.

Kumta ma phi, ki khun jong phi bad ki shakri shakor jong phi kin sa puh ïa ka khyndew na ka bynta jong u bad phin sa wan rah ïa u soh, khnang ba u khun jong u kynrad jong phi un dup ïoh la ka bam, hynrei u Mephibosheth u khun jong u kynrad jong phi un bam barabor ha ka miej jong nga.” U Ziba u la don khatsan ngut ki khun bad arphew ngut ki shakri.

Te u Ziba u la jubab ïa u syiem, “Kat kaba u kynrad syiem jong nga u hukum ïa u shakri jong u, kumta u shakri jong phi un leh.” Kumta u Mephibosheth u la bam ha ka miej u Dabid kum uwei na ki khun u syiem.
U Mephibosheth u la don uwei u khun uba dang rit, uba kyrteng u Mika. Baroh kiba shong ha ïing u Ziba ki la long ruh ki shakri u Mephibosheth.
Kumta u Mephibosheth u la shong ha Jerusalem, namar u la bam la dih barabor ha ka miej u syiem. U la dkoh baroh ar ki kjat.
Hadien kane u syiem ki Ammon u la ïap, bad u Hanun, u khun jong u, u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u.

Te u Dabid u la ong, “Ngan leh sbun ïa u Hanun, u khun u Nahash, kumba u kpa jong u u la leh sbun lem ïa nga.” Kumta u Dabid u la phah ki jingai khublei sngewlem da ki shakri jong u shaphang u kpa jong u. Ki shakri u Dabid ki la poi ha ka ri ki Ammon.

Hynrei ki rangbah raid jong ki Ammon ki la ong ha u Hanun, u kynrad jong ki, “Hato phi tharai ba u Dabid u leh burom ïa u kpa jong phi, namarba u phah ki nongpyntngen ïa phi ? Ym dei ba u Dabid u la phah ïa la ki shakri sha phi khnang ban wad jingtip shaphang ka nongbah, ban syntiat ïa ka, kumta ban ïoh pyndem ïa ka ?”
Kumta u Hanun u la shim ïa ki shakri u Dabid bad u la khi mar shiteng u ñiuhtmoh jong uwei pa uwei, nangta u la khap ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki na marpdeng haduh skhep bad u sa phah noh.

Ynda la ïathuh ïa u Dabid shaphang kane, u la phah briew ban ïakynduh ïa ki, namar kita ki briew ki la sngewlehraiñ haduh katta katta. Te u syiem u la ong, “To sah noh ha Jerikho haduh ban da san ki ñiuhtmoh jong phi, nangta sa wan phai.”

Ynda ki Ammon ki la ithuh ba ki la kylla long kiba isih hakhmat u Dabid, ki la phah wer bylla ïa ki Siria kiba na Beth-rehob, bad ïa ki Siria kiba na Zoba, arphew hajar ki pyrton kjat, ïa u syiem Maaka bad shihajar ngut ki briew, bad ïa ki nong Tob khat-ar hajar ngut ki briew.
Haba u Dabid u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la phah ïa u Joab bad ïa ki paid ’riewkhlaiñ baroh.
Ki Ammon ki la mih bad ki la ïeng riang kum ban ïaleh hamar tyngkong jong ka khyrdop, katba ki Siria na Zoba bad na Rehob, lem bad ki briew na Tob bad Maaka, ki la don tang para ma ki harud nong.
Haba u Joab u la ïohi ba la pynap ban ïaleh ïa u nakhmat bad nadien, u la jied katto katne ki ’riewkynsai ka Israel bad u la pynïeng ïa ki pyrshah ki Siria.
Ïa kiba sah u la buh hapoh ka jingïalam u Abishai u para jong u, bad u la pynïeng ïa ki pyrshah ki Ammon.
Te u la ong, “Lada ki Siria ki khlaiñ eh na ka bynta jong nga, sa wan ïarap lem ma phi ïa nga. Hynrei lada ki Ammon ki khlaiñ eh ïa phi, ngan sa wan ïarap lem ma nga ïa phi.
To long ki bashlur, bad leh ïaw na ka bynta ki paidbah jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki shnong jong u Blei jong ngi. To u Trai Un leh katba ibit ma U.
Kumta u Joab bad ki pyrton kiba don bad u ki la tur ban ïaleh ïa ki Siria, hynrei kine ki la phet krad hakhmat jong u.

Haba ki Ammon ki la ïohi ba kine ki her ïap, ki ruh ki la phet krad hakhmat u Abishai bad ki la leit phai sha ka shnong lajong. Kumta u Joab u la wan phai na kaba ïaleh ïa ki Ammon bad u la wan sha Jerusalem.
Haba ki Siria ki la ïohi ba ki la shah jop ha ki Israel, ki la ïalum lang para maki.
U Hadadezer u la phah ïalam ïa ki Siria kiba na shiliang ka Ïuphratis, bad ki la wan sha Helam ryngkat bad u Shobakh, u rangbah ki pyrton u Hadadezer, kum u nongïalam jong ki.

Haba la leit ïathuh ïa kata ha u Dabid, u la lum lang ïa ki Israel baroh bad u la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan, nangta u la leit haduh Helam. Ki Siria ki la ïeng riang pyrshah u Dabid bad ki la ïaleh ïa u.

Ki Siria ki la her ïap hakhmat ki Israel, bad u Dabid u la pynïap ïa ki shipai jong ki hynñiewspah tylli ki kali Siria, sawphew hajar ki pyrton shong kulai, bad u la pynmynsaw ïa u Shobakh, u rangbah pyrton jong ki, kumta u la ïap hangta ha shen.

Haba ki syiem baroh kiba ïabud ïa u Hadadezer ki la ïohi ba ki la shah jop ha ki Israel, ki la ïasuk noh bad ki, bad ki la kylla ki raïot jong ki. Kumta ki Siria kim shym treh ïarap lem shuh ïa ki Ammon.

Ha ka pyrem jong kata ka snem, ka por ba ki syiem ki ju leit ïaleh thma, u Dabid u la phah ïa u Joab ryngkat bad ki nongbud jong u bad ki Israel baroh. Ki la pynjulor ïa ki Ammon bad ki la kerkut ïa ka Rabba. Hynrei u Dabid u la sah ha Jerusalem.

Ka la jia ha kawei ka janmiet, haba u Dabid u la khie na jynthiah bad u dang ïaid kai halor tnum ka ïing syiem, ba u la ïohi na kliar ïing kawei ka kynthei kaba sum, bad kata ka kynthei ka la long ka babhabriew shibun eh.
Te u Dabid u la phah tohkit shaphang kata ka kynthei, bad ki la ïathuh ha u, “Ka dei ka Bathsheba, ka khun u Eliam, ka tnga u Uria nong Hit.”
Kumta u Dabid u la phah ki briew ban ïalam ïa ka. Te ka la wan sha u bad u la ïaklim bad ka. (Ha kata ka por ka dang pynkhuid ïa lade na la ka jingbymkhuid). Hadien kata ka la leit phai sha la ïing.
Te kata ka kynthei ka la pun bad ka la phah ïathuh ha u Dabid, “Nga la seng khun.”
Kumta u Dabid u la phah ktien sha u Joab, “Phah sha nga ïa u Uria nong Hit.” Bad u Joab u la phah ïa u Uria sha u Dabid.
Haba u Uria u la wan sha u, u Dabid u la kylli kumno u Joab u leh, kumno ki paid ki leh, bad kumno ka thma ka ïaid.
Nangta u Dabid u la ong ha u Uria, “Khie sha ïing lajong bad sait ïa la ki kjat.” Te u Uria u la mih na ïing u syiem, bad la phah nadien jong u kawei ka jynai sngewbha na u syiem.
Hynrei u Uria u la thiah ha jynkhang ka ïing u syiem lem bad ki shakri baroh jong u kynrad jong u, bad um shym leit hiar sha ïing lajong.
Haba ki la ïathuh ïa u Dabid, “U Uria um shym leit hiar sha ïing lajong,” u Dabid u la ong ha u Uria, “Hato phim shym wan na ba leit jingleit ? Balei phim shym leit hair artat sha la ïing ?”

U Uria u la jubab, “Ka synduk jutang, ki Israel bad ki Juda ki ïashong ha ki ïing dara; u kynrad jong nga, u Joab, bad ki nongbud u kynrad jong nga ki ïashong dara ha madan, hato nga pat de ngan leit sha ïing lajong ban bam ban dih, bad ban ïathiah bad ka tnga jong nga ? Kumba u Blei U im bad kumba ma phi ruh phi im, ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaei kaba kum kane.”
Nangta u Dabid u la ong ha u Uria, “To sah hangne mynta ka sngi ruh bad lashai ngan sa shah ba phin leit.” Kumta u Uria u la sah ha Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi bad kum lashai.

U Dabid u la khot sngewbha ïa u, bad u la bam bad u, bad u la pyndih ïa u haduh ba un da buaid. Ynda miet, u Uria u la leit thiah ha la ka jynthiah bad ki shakri jong u kynrad, hynrei um shym leit satia sha ïing lajong.
Ynda mynstep u Dabid u la thoh ka shithi sha u Joab bad u la ai ïa ka ha ka kti u Uria.
Ha ka shithi u la thoh, “Buh ïa u Uria hakhmat duh ha bajur eh ka jingïaleh, nangta phet noh na u, ba un dup shah pom bad un ïap.”
Te katba u Joab u dang kerkut ïa ka nongbah, u la ai bynta ïa u Uria ha ka jaka kaba u tip ba don ki briew ki bakhlaiñ.
Ki briew na kata ka shnong ki la mih bad ki la ïaleh bad u Joab; don ki rangbah shipai u Dabid kiba la kyllon. U Uria nong Hit ruh u la shah pynïap.
U Joab u la phah ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingïaleh.
U la bthah ïa u nongrah khubor, “Haba phi la dep ïathuh ha u syiem ïa ka khubor baroh shaphang ka jingïaleh,
te lada u syiem u khie bitar bad u ong ha phi, “Balei phi leit jan eh ha shnong ban ïaleh ? Hato phim tip ba kin siat na ka kynroh ?

Uei uba la pynïap ïa u Abimelek, khun u Jerubbesheth ? Hato ym dei ka kynthei kaba la kawang ïa u da u maw tylliat na ka kynroh bad kumta u la ïap ha Thebes ? Balei phi la leit tur haduh jan kynroh ?’ nangta phin ïathuh, ‘U shakri jong phi u Uria nong Hit ruh u la ïap.’ ”
Kumta u nongrah khubor u la leit bad u la wan ïathuh ïa u Dabid kat kaba u Joab u la phah ïathuh.
U nongrah khubor u la ïathuh ïa u Dabid, “Ki briew jong ki ki la ïoh dong ïa ngi bad ki la tur pyrshah ïa ngi haduh madan, hynrei ngi la pynher biang ïa ki haduh tyngkong ka khyrdop.
Hangta ki nongsiat khnam ki la siat ïa ki nongbud jong phi na ka kynroh. Katno katne ngut na ki nongbud jong phi ki la ïap, bad u shakri jong phi ruh u Uria nong Hit u la ïap.”

U Dabid u la ong ha u nongrah khubor, “Phin ong kumne ha u Joab, ‘Wat pynkhuslai ïa lade namar kane, namar ka waitlam ka bam, shisien uwei shisien uwei pat. Pynkhlaiñ ka jingïaleh ïa ka nongbah haduh ba phin da pynkhyllem ïa ka.’ Pynshlur ïa u ruh.”
Haba ka tnga u Uria ka la ïohsngew ba u Uria u tnga jong ka u la ïap, ka la ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u tnga jong ka.
Ynda la kut ka por ïam briew, u Dabid u la phah ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong u. Ka la kylla ka tnga jong u bad ka la kha u khun na u. Hynrei ka jingleh u Dabid ka la pynsngewsih ïa u Trai.
Te u Trai U la phah ïa u Nathan sha u Dabid. U la wan sha u bad u la ong, “La don ar ngut ki briew ha kawei ka shnong, uwei u bariewspah, uwei pat u baduk.
U bariewspah u la don shibun bah ki kynhun blang kynhun jynri;

hynrei u baduk um don ei ei lait tang iwei i ’langkynthei i barit iba u la thied. Te u la sumar bha ïa i bad i la heh la san bad u, bad ki khun jong u. I ju bam na ka pliang jong u, i ju dih na ka khuri jong u, i ju thiah ha ka shadem jong u, bad i la long la kum ka khun jong u.

Te la wan uwei u nongleit jingleit sha uta u bariewspah. Une um treh ban shim da kano kano ka blang ne ka jynri lajong ban pynkhreh na ka bynta uta u nongleit jingleit uba la wan sha u, hynrei u la shim ïa ita i blang rit jong u baduk bad u la pynkhreh da i na ka bynta uta u briew uba la wan sha u.”
Hangta ka jingbitar u Dabid ka la khie ir pyrshah uta u briew, bad u la ong ha u Nathan, “Kumba u Trai U im, uta u briew uba la leh ïa kane u dawa ban ïap.
Un sa dei ban pynphai ïa i khun blang saw shah, namarba u la leh ïa kane, bad namarba um don jingsngewsynei.”
U Nathan u la ong ha u Dabid, “Dei ma phi uta u briew ! U ong kumne u Trai u Blei ka Israel, ‘Nga la pynsleh ïa phi ban long u syiem ka Israel bad Nga la pyllait ïa phi na ka kti u Saul.

Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka ïing u kynrad jong phi bad ïa ki tnga u kynrad jong phi ha ka shadem jong phi, nangta ïa ka ïing Israel bad ka ïing Juda. Lada kane ka dang khyndiat eh, Ngan dang ai shuh shuh ïa phi.

Balei pat de phi la ibeiñ ïa ki hukum u Trai da kaba leh ïa ka basniew hakhmat jong U ? Phi la pynïap ïa u Uria nong Hit da ka waitlam, phi la knieh ïa ka tnga jong u ban long ka tnga jong phi, bad phi la pynïap ïa u da ka waitlam ki Ammon.
Namarkata ka waitlam kan ym khlad shuh na ka ïing jong phi, namarba phi la ibeiñ ïa Nga, bad phi la knieh ïa ka tnga u Uria nong Hit ban long ka tnga jong phi.’

Kumta u Trai U ong, ‘Hakhmih Ngan pynmih ka jingsniew pyrshah ïa phi na ka ïing jong phi hi. Ngan knieh ïa ki tnga jong phi nakhmat jong phi bad Ngan ai ïa ki ha u para marjan jong phi, nangta un sa ïaleh sang bad ki tnga jong phi haba ïohi ki briew baroh.
Phi phi la leh ha ka barieh, hynrei Ngan leh ïa kane ha ka bapaw, hakhmat ki Israel baroh.’ ”
U Dabid u la ong ha u Nathan, “Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa u Trai !” U Nathan u la ong ha u Dabid, “U Trai ruh U la pyndam ïa ka pap jong phi; phin ym ïap.
Lajar katta, namarba da kane ka kam phi la kyntait ïa u Trai nadong shadong, u khun ba phin ïoh un sa ïap.”
Nangta u Nathan u la leit sha la ïing. Te u Trai U la pynshitom ïa u khunlung ba la kha ka tnga u Uria ïa u Dabid, bad u la pang.
U Dabid u la kyrpad ïa u Blei na ka bynta u khunlung; u la shah jingit, u la leit sha ïing bad u la thiah ha madan baroh shi miet.
Ki rangbah jong ka ïing jong u ki la wan, ki la kyrpad ïa u ban khie na khyndew; hynrei um treh, bad um treh bam jynbam bad ki.

Ha ka sngi ka bahynñiew, u khunlung u la ïap. Ki shakri u Dabid ki la tieng ban ïathuh ïa u ba u khunlung u la ïap, namar ki la ong, “Ha peit, haba dang im u khunlung, ngi kren ha u, hynrei um treh shah shkor ïa ngi; te kumno ngin ïathuh ïa u ba u khunlung u la ïap ? U lah ban pynmynsaw pynban ïa lade.”
Hynrei haba u Dabid u la ïohi ba ki shakri ki ïa pasiaw lang, u la sngewthuh ba u khunlung u la ïap. U Dabid u la kylli ïa ki shakri jong u, “Hato u khunlung u la ïap ?” Ki la jubab, “U la ïap.”

Hangta u Dabid u la khie na khyndew, u la sum la sleh ïa lade bad u la pli jaiñ, nangta u la leit sha ïing u Trai bad u la mane. Nangta u la leit sha la ïing, u la pan jynbam bad u la bam baroh ka jynbam kat kaba ki la buh hakhmat jong u.
Te ki shakri ki la kylli ïa u, “Ka mut aïu kane kaba phi leh ? Phi la shah jingit bad phi la ïam na ka bynta u khunlung haba u dang im, hynrei haba u la ïap phi khie bam khie dih pynban.”
U la ong, “Katba u khunlung u dang im, nga la shah jingit bad nga la ïam, namar nga la ong, ‘Ei ba tip lehse u Trai Un sngewsynei ïa nga, bad u khunlung u lah ban im ?’
Hynrei mynta u la ïap, balei nga dei ban shah jingit ? Hato nga lah ban pynim biang ïa u ? Ngan sa leit sha u, u pat un ym wan phai sha nga.”
Te u Dabid u la pyntngen ïa ka tnga jong u, ka Bathsheba, u la ïashong bad ka, bad ka la kha uwei u khun, ïa uba u khot kyrteng Solomon. U Trai U la ieid ïa u,
bad U la phah ïa u Nathan nongïathuhlypa ban jer kyrteng ïa u ‘U Jedidia’—ha ka burom jong u Trai.
U Joab u la ïaleh pyrshah ka Rabba jong ki Ammon, bad u la ïoh knieh ïa ka nongbah syiem.
U Joab u la phah ki nongrah khubor sha u Dabid, u ong, “Nga la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Rabba, bad nga la ïoh knieh ïa ki tlong um jong ka.
Te mynta lum lang ïa ki paid baroh kiba dang sah, wan ker tawiar ïa ka nongbah bad jop ïa ka, ïoh nga jop ma nga bad nga ai da ka kyrteng jong nga ïa ka.”
Kumta u Dabid u la lum lang ïa ki paid baroh bad u la leit pyrshah ka Rabba; u la ïaleh ïa ka, bad u la ïoh knieh artat.

U la knieh ïa ka pansngiat u syiem jong ki na ka khlieh jong u. Ka jingkhia jong ka kat shi talen ka ksiar, bad ha ka la don uwei u maw u bakordor. La pynphong ïa ka ha ka khlieh u Dabid. U la wan rah shikatdei bah ka mar kliarwait na ka nongbah.

U la ïalam noh ïa ki trai shnong jong ka bad u la pyntrei ïa ki da ki kurat bad ki nar puh bad ki sdie, bad u la phah trei ïa ki ha ki pajwa maw-it. U la leh kumne ha ki shnong baroh jong ki Ammon. Nangta u Dabid bad ki paid jong u baroh ki la wan phai sha Jerusalem.
Hadien khyndiat por, ka la jia kane ka jingjia. U Absalom u khun u Dabid u la don ka para ka babhabriew, kaba kyrteng ka Tamar; u Amnon, u khun u Dabid, u la i bha ïa ka.
U Amnon u la sngewkhuslai haduh katta katta na ka bynta ka para arkmie jong u ka Tamar ba u la kem pang. Namar ba ka long ka theisotti, u Amnon um i don lad da kumno kumno ban leh ei ei ïa ka.
Hynrei u Amnon u la don u lok uba kyrteng u Jonadab, u khun u Shimea, uba shipara bad u Dabid, bad u Jonadab u la long u briew u basianti sniew shibun.
Une u la ong ha u, “Ko khun u syiem, balei phi nangraikhoh nangring ? Phin ym ïathuh ïa nga ?” U Amnon u la ïathuh ïa u, “Nga ieid ïa ka Tamar, ka para u hynmen jong nga u Absalom.”

U Jonadab u la ong ha u, “Phi thiah ha jynthiah lajong bad leh mynleh pang, bad haba u kpa jong phi u wan peit ïa phi, ong ha u, ‘Phah wan da ka para jong nga ka Tamar ban ai jynbam ïa nga, bad ban pynkhreh ïa ka jynbam hakhmat jong nga ba ngan dup ïohi ïa ka bad ban bam ïa ka na ka kti jong ka.’ ”

Kumta u Amnon u la thiah bad u la leh mynleh pang. Haba u syiem u la wan peit ïa u, u Amnon u la ong ha u syiem, “Sngewbha seh shah ba ka para kha jong nga ka Tamar kan wan pynkhreh ar tylli ki kpu hakhmat jong nga ba ngan dup ïoh bam na ka kti jong ka.”
Te u Dabid u la phah ktien sha ïing sha ka Tamar, u ong, “Khie leit sha ïing u hynmen jong phi u Amnon ban pynkhreh jynbam na ka bynta jong u.”
Kumta ka Tamar ka la leit sha ka ïing u hynmen jong ka u Amnon ha kaba u thiah pang. Te ka la shim shi lynglun u ’pulwet, ka la khñiot ïa u, ka la thaw kpu hakhmat jong u bad ka la shet ïa ki kpu.
Nangta ka la shim ïa ka nar sdieh bad ka la theh ïa ka hakhmat jong u hynrei um treh bam. U Amnon u la ong, “Phah ki briew baroh kin leit noh nangne.” Kumta baroh ki la leit noh shabar.

Te u Amnon u la ong ha ka Tamar, “Wan rah ïa ka jynbam hapoh kamra, ba ngan bam na ka kti jong phi.” Ka Tamar ka la shim ïa ki kpu ba ka la shet, bad ka la leit rah ïa ki hapoh kamra ha u Amnon u hynmen jong ka.
Hynrei haba ka la wan rah ïa ki hajan jong u ba un bam, u la bat ïa ka, bad u la ong ha ka, “Ale thiah bad nga, ko hep.”
Ka la jubab, “Em, ko bah, wat leh bor ïa nga, namar ym ju leh ïa kum kane kaei kaei ha Israel. Wat leh ïa kane ka kam lamwir.
Nga ngan kit shaei ïa la ka jinglehraiñ ? Phi ruh phin sa long uwei na ki lamwir ha Israel. Nga kyrpad ïa phi, namarkata, ban leit kren ha u syiem; un ym khang ïa nga na phi.”
Hynrei um sngap ïa ka. Ba u kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka, u la leh bor ïa ka bad u la lehsang bad ka.
Te u Amnon u la isih ïa ka da ka jingisih ka bakhraw shibun, haduh ba ka jingisih jong u ïa ka ka kham palat ban ïa ka jingieid ba u la ieid ïa ka. U Amnon u la ong ha ka. “Ïeng, khie leit noh.”
Hynrei ka la ong ha u, “Em, ko bah, namar ban phah noh ïa nga kumne ka long ka jinglehbeiñ ka ba kham khraw ban ïa kato kaba phi la leh ïa nga.” Hynrei um sngap satia ïa ka.
U la khot ïa u samla uba shakri ïa u bad u la ong, “Sei shabar ïa kane ka kynthei nakhmat jong nga, bad khangnar ïa ka jynkhang nadien jong ka.”
Te ka la phong da ka sopti baphalang, kumba ju kup mynhyndai ki khun syiem ba dang sotti. Kumta u shakri jong u u la sei ïa ka shabar, bad u la khang nar ïa ka jynkhang ka tang shu mih.
Ka Tamar ka la sum da u dpei ïa la ka khlieh bad ka la kad ïa ka jaiñkup jynsur ba ka kup, nangta ka la buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh, bad ka la leit noh, ka da ïam lynñiar artat lynti.

Te u hynmen jong ka u Absalom u la kylli ïa ka, “Hato u Amnon u hynmen jong phi u la don ei ei bad phi ? Phi shu sngap, ko hep; dei u hynmen jong phi; wat khuslai palat shaphang kane.” Kumta ka Tamar ka la sah ka rangli ha ïing u hynmen jong ka u Absalom.
Haba u Dabid u la ïohsngew ïa kine kiei kiei baroh, u la bitar.
Hynrei u Absalom um shym kren ïa u Amnon wat shikyntien ruh, naba u la isih ïa u ba u leh bor ïa ka para jong u ka Tamar.
Hadien ar snem pura u Absalom u la don ki nongot shñiuh ’langbrot ha Baal-hazor, kaba hajan Ephraim. U Absalom u la khot sngewbha ïa ki khun baroh jong u syiem.
U Absalom u la wan ha u syiem bad u la ong, “U shakri jong phi u don ki nongot shñiuh ’langbrot. Sngewbha seh, phi ko syiem bad ki rangbah kam jong phi, ïawan bad u shakri jong phi.”
Hynrei u syiem u la ong ha u Absalom, “Em, ko khun, ynnai ïaleit baroh phar, ïoh ngi long jingwit ïa phi.” Une u la ïaibán ïa u, hynrei um treh leit bad u la shu ai ïa u tang ka jingkyrkhu.
Nangta u Absalom u la ong, “Lada ym long, ieh un leit bad ngi la kumno kumno u para jong nga u Amnon.” U syiem u la ong, ha u, “Balei u dei ban leit bad phi ?”
Hynrei u la ïaibán haduh ba u la shah ba u Amnon bad ki khun baroh jong u syiem kin ïaleit bad u.

Te u Absalom u la hukum ïa ki shakri jong u baroh, “Peit thuh, haba u Amnon u la shongshit waiñ, nga tang shu ong ïa phi, ‘Pom ïa u Amnon’, hangta pynïap ïa u. Wat tieng; ym dei ma nga uba hukum ïa phi ? To long ki bashlur bad ki badohsnieh.”
Kumta ki shakri u Absalom ki la leh ïa u Amnon kumba u Absalom u la hukum ïa ki. Te baroh ki khun u syiem ki la ïeng bad ki la phet, ki la ïashong mar la u khashor.
Katba ki dang don ha lynti, la poi khubor ha u Dabid, “U Absalom u la pynïap ïa ki khun baroh jong u syiem, uwei ruh um shym lait.”
Hangta u Dabid u la ïeng bad u la kad ïa la ki jaiñphong bad u la thiah ha khyndew; ki shakri jong u kiba don hangta, ma ki ruh ki la ïakad ïa la ki jaiñphong.

Hynrei u Jonadab, u khun u Shimea, uba shi para bad u Dabid, u la ong, “To u kynrad jong nga un ym tharai ba ki la pynïap ïa ki khun samla baroh jong u syiem. Tang u Amnon marwei u la ïap, naba da ka hukum u Absalom ïa kane la lah rai naduh ka sngi ba une u la leh bor ïa ka para jong u ka Tamar.
To u kynrad syiem jong nga um dei ban khuslai ba ki khun baroh jong u syiem ki la ïap, haba tang u Amnon u la ïap.”
Hapdeng kata ka por u Absalom u la phet. Te uwei u samla uba dei ban ap phira, u la khmied ïa la ki khmat bad u la ïohi shibun ki briew kiba wan na ka lynti Horonaim kaba ha ranab lum.
U Jonadab u la ong ha u syiem, “Ha peit, ki khun u syiem ki la wan. Kumba la ïathuh u shakri jong phi, kumta ka la urlong.”
U tang shu dep ban kren, ki khun u syiem ki la wan, ki la kren jam bad ki la ïam. U syiem bad ki rangbah kam jong u ruh ki la ïaïam kthang shibun.
Hynrei u Absalom u la phet bad u la leit sha u Talmai, u khun u Ammihud, u syiem Geshur,
bad u la sah lai snem hangta. U Dabid u la ïam briew man ka sngi ïa u khun lajong,
hynrei katba ka nangjngai ka jingïap u Amnon, ka dohnud u syiem ka nangkwah nangkwah ban ïakynduh noh ïa u Absalom.
Te u Joab khun u Zeruïa u la ïohi ba u syiem u la angnud ïa u Absalom.

Kumta u la phah briew sha Tekoa ban wan ïalam nangta ïa kawei ka briew ka bastad, bad u la ong ha ka, “Phi leh mynleh kum ka basngewsih, bad phong da ki jaiñ leh sngewsih. Wat sleh umphniang hynrei leh kum ka kynthei kaba la ïam briew la bun sngi na ka bynta uba la ïap.
Nangta leit sha u syiem, bad ong kumne ha u.” Bad u la bthah aïu ka dei ban ong.
Haba kata ka briew na Tekoa ka la wan sha u syiem, ka la dem ngon haduh khyndew, ka la nguh la dem, bad ka la ong, “Ïarap, ko syiem !”
U syiem hangta u la ong ha ka, ‘Phi shem jynjar aïu ?” Ka la jubab, “Adur lanot, nga long ka ’riewkynthei, u tnga jong nga u la ïap.
Ka shakri jong phi ka la don ar ngut ki khun, hynrei ki la ïakajia ha lyngkha, bad namar ba ym don mano mano ban pynïakhlad ïa ki, uwei u la pom ïa uwei pat bad u la pynïap ïa u.

Te baroh shi ïing shi sem ki la ïaïeng pyrshah ïa ka shakri jong phi, ki ong, “Ai te ai ïa u briew uba la pynïap ïa la u para, ba ngin pynïap ïa u na ka bynta ka jingim jong u para ba u la pynïap; bad kumta ki kwah ban pynduh ïa u nongïoh pateng ruh. Ha kane ka rukom, ki kwah ban pynlip ïa u rnga ding jong nga uba dang sah bad ban ym pynsah nam ne dyngkhong ïa u tnga jong nga ha sla khyndew.”
Te u syiem u la ong ha kata ka kynthei, “Khie leit sha la ïing, bad ngan sa pynmih hukum shaphang jong phi.”
Kata ka kynthei na Tekoa ka la ong ha u syiem, “Shaphang kane ngan kit pop ma nga bad ka ïing ka sem u kpa jong nga, ko syiem kynrad. U syiem bad ka khet jong u kin khuid.”
U syiem u la ong, “Lada don mano mano ba ong ei ei ha phi, ïalam ïa u sha nga, bad yn ym ktah shuh ïa phi.”

Te ka la ong, “To u syiem un kyrpad ïa u Trai u Blei jong phi ba u nongwad kput snam un ym pynïap shuh, bad u khun jong nga ruh un ym shah pynïap.” U la ong, “Kumba u Trai U im, wat uwei u shñiuh jong u khun jong phi un ym hap ha khyndew.”
Hangta kata ka briew ka la ong, “Sngewbha shah ïa ka shakri jong phi ban kren sa shi kyntien ha u syiem kynrad jong nga.” U la ong, “To kren.”

Kata ka briew ka la ong, “Da kaba ai kum kane ka rai, u syiem u pynrem ïa lade. Namar, balei phi leh kumne pyrshah u paid u Blei, da kaba ym shah wan biang sha ïing lajong ïa u khun ba phi la beh shnong ?

Ngi baroh ngi dei ban ïap, ngi long kum ka um kaba la hoit ha khyndew ïa kaba ym lah shuh ban tong pynlang biang. Hynrei u Blei Un pynsah ïa ka jingim jong uta uba wad lad ba yn ym taitduh ïa uba la shah beh shnong.

Nga la wan ong ïa kane mynta ha u syiem kynrad jong nga namar ki briew ki la pyntieng ïa nga. Ka shakri jong phi ka la pyrkhat, ‘Ngan kren ha u syiem, lehse u syiem un pyndep ïa ka jingkyrpad ka shakri jong u.
Naba ynda u syiem u ïohsngew, un pyllait ïa la ka shakri na ka kti jong u briew uba mut ban pynduh na nga bad na u khun jong nga ïa ka hok pateng jong u Blei.’

Te ka shakri jong phi ka la pyrkhat, “Ka ktien jong u syiem kynrad jong nga kan pyntngen jai ïa nga, namar u syiem kynrad jong nga u long kum u angel jong u Blei ban ithuh ïa ka babha bad ka basniew. To u Trai u Blei jong phi Un don ryngkat bad phi !”
Te u syiem u la jubab ïa kata ka briew, “Wat buhrieh ei ei na kaba ngan sa kylli ïa phi.” Kata ka briew ka la ong, “To kren, ko syiem kynrad jong nga.”

U syiem u la ong, “Hato u Joab u don kti bad phi ha kane baroh ?” Kata ka briew ka la jubab, “Kumba phi im ko syiem kynrad, ngam lah ban len: ka long thik kumba u syiem kynrad jong nga u la ong. Dei u shakri jong phi keiñ, u Joab, uba la hukum ïa nga. Dei ma u uba la bthah ïa kine ki ktien baroh ha ka shakri jong phi.
U shakri jong phi u la leh kumne khnang ban buhrieh ïa la ka jingmut. Hynrei u kynrad jong nga u don ka jingstad kaba kum ka jong u angel u Blei ban tip lut ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ka khyndew.”
Te u syiem u la ong ha u Joab, “Ñiuma, nga shah ïa kane. Khie leit shaw noh ïa uto u samla u Absalom.”

U Joab u la dem ngon haduh khyndew, u la nguh la dem bad u la kyrkhu ïa u syiem, u ong artat, “Mynta ka sngi u shakri jong phi u tip ba u la ïoh jingñiew burom hakhmat jong phi, u syiem kynrad jong nga, namar u la ai ïa ka jingkyrpad u shakri jong u.”
Kumta u Joab u la ïeng bad u la leit ïalam ïa u Absalom na Geshur sha Jerusalem.
U syiem u la ong, “Ieh un shong kyrpang ha la ka jong ka ïing. Um dei ban wan hakhmat jong nga.” Kumta u Absalom u la shong kyrpang ha ïing lajong bad um shym leit paw hakhmat u syiem.
Ha Israel baroh kawei ym don mano mano ba ïoh jingïaroh kum u Absalom na ka bynta ka jingbhabriew jong u. Naduh pohjat haduh shynrong khlieh ym don jingthohbria ei ei ha u.
Haba u khi ïa la u shñiuh (man ba kut ka snem u shait khi ïa u, bad um banse ban khi namar ba u khia), u thew ïa u da ka tarajur u syiem bad u khia arspah shekel.
U Absalom u la ïoh khun shynrang lai ngut bad kawei ka khun kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Tamar, ka kynthei ka babhabriew.
Kumta u Absalom u la shong ar snem pura ha Jerusalem khlem da paw hakhmat u syiem.
Te u Absalom u la phah khot ïa u Joab ba un ïoh phah ïa u sha u syiem, hynrei u Joab um treh wan satia. Sa shisien u la phah khot hynrei u Joab um treh wan.

Hangta u la ong ha la ki shakri, “Peit, ka lyngkha u Joab ka ïasyndah bad ka jong nga, bad u don u barli hangta. Khie wiang ïa ka da ka ding.” Kumta ki shakri u Absalom ki la wiang ding ïa ka lyngkha.
Markumta u Joab u la mih bad u la leit sha u Absalom ha ïing jong u bad u la ong ha u, “Balei sha ki shakri jong phi ki leit wiang ding ïa ka lyngkha jong nga ?”

U Absalom u la jubab ïa u Joab, “Ha peit, nga la khot ïa phi hangne ban phah ïa phi ban kylli ïa u syiem: ‘Ban lei nga la wan na Geshur ? La kham bha ba nga dang sah hangta.” Te mynta shuh ngan leit hakhmat u syiem, bad lada dang don pop ha nga, ieh un pynïap ïa nga.”

Kumta u Joab u la leit sha u syiem bad u la ïathuh ïa kane ha u. U syiem u la phah wan ïa u Absalom, uba la wan sha u mar mar, bad u la nguh ïa la ka khmat haduh khyndew. U syiem u la doh ïa u Absalom.
Hadien kane u Absalom u la khreh kawei ka kali bad ki kulai, bad sanphew ngut ki briew kiban mareh hakhmat jong u.

U Absalom u shait khie thiah dang step bad u ïeng harud ka lynti kaba leit sha khyrdop. Haba don uno uno u briew uba wan sha u syiem na ka bynta ka kam bishar, u Absalom u shait khot ïa u bad u ong, “Na ka shnong aïu phi wan ?” Haba uta u jubab, “U shakri jong phi u dei na kata kata ka jait Israel,”
u Absalom un ong ha u, “Peit, ki jingdawa jong phi ki long ki babha bad ki badei, hynrei u syiem um shym thung briew ïano ïano ban sngap ïa phi.”
Nangta u Absalom un ong, “A ban da long nongbishar ma nga ha ka ri ! Hangta man la u briew uba don jingïakajia ne jingïamudui un wan sha nga, bad ngan bishar hok ïa u.”
Kat haba don u briew uba wan hajan ban nguh burom ïa u, u ju sei ïa la ka kti, bad u bat ïa u, nangta u sa doh ïa u.
U Absalom u la ju leh kumne ïa ki Israel baroh kiba wan sha u syiem ban ïoh jingbishar. Da kane ka buit u Absalom u la khring ïa ki dohnud jong ki paid Israel.
Ynda la kut saw snem, u Absalom u la ong ha u syiem, “Sngewbha seh shah ïa nga ban leit sha Hebron ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular niam kaba nga la khlei ha u Trai.
Naba u shakri jong phi u la khlei ïa kane ka jingkular niam mynba u shong ha Geshur ha Aram, ‘Lada u Trai Un wanlam biang ïa nga sha Jerusalem, te ngan tyrwa ka nguh ka dem ha u Trai ha Hebron.’ ”
U syiem u la ong ha u, “Khie leit suk.” Kumta u la ïeng bad u la leit sha Hebron.
Hynrei u Absalom u la phah briew jar jar kylleng ki jait Israel, u ong, “Phi tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka jingput ka turoi, hangta to pyrta shnong, ‘U Absalom u long syiem ha Hebron!’ ”
Arspah ngut ki briew ki la leit bad u Absalom na Jerusalem kum kiba shu shah khot sngewbha. Ki la leit da ka jingshida khlem da tip ei ei.

Katba u Absalom u dang tyrwa jynkñia, u la phah khot ïa u Ahithopel u nong Gilo, u myntri jong u Dabid, na Gilo ka shnong jong u. Ka jingïasylla ka la nangkhlaiñ bad kiba bud ïa u Absalom ki la nangbun.
Te la wan poi u nongrah khubor sha u Dabid, u ong, “Ki dohnud jong ki Israel ki la noh sha u Absalom.”

Hangta u Dabid u la ong ha ki nongbud jong u baroh kiba don ha Jerusalem, “Ïeng, ïa ngin ïaphet; lymda kumta ngin ym lait na u Absalom. Leit kloi kloi, ïoh u wan lap ïa ngi kyndit kyndit, un jop ïa ngi bad un pom ïa ka nongbah da ka waitlam.”
Ki nongbud u syiem ki la ong ha u, “Ki nongbud jong phi ki la kloi ban leh katba rai u syiem kynrad jong ngi.”
Kumta u syiem u la mih bak bak, bad kiba ha ïing ha sem jong u ki la bud nadien. U syiem u la ieh noh shiphew ngut ki tnga kliar ban peit ïa ka ïing.
Te u syiem u la leit bad ki paid baroh kiba bud ïa u, bad ki la sangeh ha ka ïing kaba khatduh duh,
katba ki pyrton jong u ki la nangïaid shakhmat jong u. Baroh ki Khereth, baroh ki Peleth, baroh ki Gitt, hynriewspah ngut kiba la wan bud ïa u na Gath, ki la ïaid shaphrang nakhmat u syiem.
Te u syiem u la ong ha u Ittai u nong Gitt, “Balei phi ruh phin ïawan bad ngi ? Leit phai noh, bad sah bad u syiem bathymmai. Phi long u nongwei, uba la shah beh na ïing lajong.

Phi la wan dang hynnin, hato ngan pynïaid makia kylleng kylleng ïa phi, haba ngam tip shaei ngan leit ? Khie noh, ïalam ïa la ki hynmen ki para bad phi. To u Trai Un ieid sbun bad pynneh jutang bad phi.”
Hynrei u Ittai u la jubab “Kumba u Trai U im bad kumba u syiem kynrad jong nga u im, kat haba un don u syiem kynrad jong nga, la ïap la im, hangta ruh u shakri jong phi un don.”
Kumta u Dabid u la ong ha u Ittai “Te khie leit shaphrang.” U Ittai nong Gitt u la ïaid shaphrang ryngkat bad la ki briew bad ki barit baria kiba don bad u.
Te ka ri baroh ka la ïam lynñiar katba u paid baroh u ïaid shaphrang; hangta u syiem u jam sha shiliang ka wah rit Kidron, bad ki paidbah baroh ki nangïaid shaphrang ka ri kynjah.
Te la wan kiew u Abiathar, bad u Zadok ruh lem bad ki Lebi baroh, ki ïabah ïa ka synduk ka jutang u Blei; ki la buh ha tbian ïa ka synduk u Blei haduh ba ki paid baroh ki la mih na ka nongbah.

Te u Dabid u la ong ha u Zadok, “Khie rah biang ïa ka synduk u Blei sha ka nongbah. Lada u Trai U dang isynei ïa nga, Un sa pynphai biang ïa nga bad Un pyni biang ha nga ïa ka bad ïa ka jaka shong jong U.
Hynrei lada U ong, ‘Ngam don jingsngewbha shuh ïa phi,’ hakhmih nga don hangne, ieh Un leh ïa nga katba U ibit ma U.”

U syiem u la ong ruh ha u Zadok lyngdoh, “Peit, leit phai noh sha ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk, ma phi bad u Abiathar, lem bad ki khun jong phi ar ngut, u Ahimaaz u khun jong phi, bad u Jonathan u khun u Abiathar.
Kynmaw, ngan ap ha ki jaka madan wah jong ka ri kynjah haduh ban da ïoh ktien na phi ban pyntip ïa nga.”
Kumta u Zadok bad u Abiathar ki la rah biang ïa ka synduk u Blei sha Jerusalem, bad ki la sah hangta.

U Dabid u la kiew ïa ka ranab lum Olib, u ïam artat katba u ïaid, khlem jynsop ïa ki kjat, bad u tap ïa la ka khlieh. Baroh ki briew kiba ïadon bad u ki la tap ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la ïakiew da kaba ïam artat ha lynti.
Te la ïathuh ha u Dabid, “U Ahithophel u long uwei na ki nongïasylla bad u Absalom.” Te u Dabid u la ong, “A Trai, nga kyrpad ïa Me, to pynkylla kam biej ïa ka jingai buit u Ahithophel.”
Haba u Dabid u la poi ha kliar, ha ka jaka ba ju mane ïa u Blei, u Hushai nong Arkhi u la wan ïakynduh ïa u, bad ka sopti kaba la kad, bad ka khlieh ba la ber da u pum pum.
U Dabid u la ong ha u, “Lada phi wan ryngkat bad nga, phin long ka jingwit ïa nga.

Hynrei lada phi leit phai sha ka nongbah bad phi ong ha u Absalom, ‘Ngan long u shakri jong phi, ko syiem; kumba nga la long u shakri jong u kpa jong phi mynshuwa, mynta ruh ngan long u shakri jong phi,’ kumta phin jop ïa ka jingai buit u Ahithophel na ka bynta jong nga.
Hato um don u Zadok bad u Abiathar ki lyngdoh ryngkat bad phi hangthie ? Kumta kat kaba phi ïohsngew na ïing u syiem, ïathuh ïa kata ha u Zadok bad u Abiathar, ki lyngdoh.
Ki khun jong ki ar ngut ki don bad ki hangthie, u Ahimaaz, u khun u Zadok, bad u Jonathan, u khun u Abiathar. Da ki phin sa pyntip ïa nga kat kaba phi ïohsngew.”
Kumta u Hushai, u lok jong u Dabid, u la leit phai sha ka nongbah, thik hamar ba u Absalom u dang rung ha Jerusalem.

Haba u Dabid u la poi palat khyndiat ïa ka kliarlum, u Ziba u shakri u Mephibosheth u la ïakynduh ïa u. Une u la don artylli ki kada ba la tehjin, ki la kit ar spah tylli ki lyngkhot kpu, shispah tyrjup ki soh waiñ tyrkhong, bun jait ki kynja soh lyïur, bad shi lwa ka waiñ.

Te u syiem u la ong ha u Ziba, “Balei phi la wanlam ïa kine ?” U Ziba u la jubab, “Ki kada ki long ban shong kiba ha ïing ha sem u syiem, u kpu bad u soh lyïur ban bam ki samla, bad ka waiñ ban dih kito kiba thait ha ri kynjah.”

U syiem te u la ong, “Haei pat de u khun jong u kynrad jong phi ?” U Ziba u la ong ha u syiem, “U sah ha Jerusalem, namar u la ong, ‘Mynta ka sngi ka ïing Israel kan sa ai biang ha nga ïa ka hima u kpa jong nga.’ ”
Nangta u syiem u la ong ha u Ziba, “Baroh kaba dei ka jong u Mephibosheth ka long ka jong phi mynta.” U Ziba pat u la ong, “Nga nguh nga dem ïa phi; to sngewsynei ïa nga barabor, ko syiem kynrad.”
Haba u syiem Dabid u la poi ha Bahurim, la mih shabar uwei u briew uba ïadei kur bad u Saul, uba kyrteng u Shimei, u khun u Gera, bad une u la tim ïaïaid khlem sangeh.
U la kawang da ki maw ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki nongbud baroh jong u syiem, te ki paidbah bad ki ’riewkhlaiñ baroh ki la ïada ïa u na sha kamon bad sha kadiang.
U Shimei u la tim da kine ki ktien, “Khie noh, khie noh, me u kynja nongshohnoh, me u kynja ’riewdakaid !

U Trai U la pynhiar kput ha me ïa ka snam baroh jong ka ïing u Saul, ba me mih bujli kum u syiem. U Trai U la ai ïa ka jingsynshar ha ka kti u khun jong me u Absalom. Ha peit, ka jingjot ka la lap ïa me, namar me dei u kynja nongshohnoh.”
Te u Abishai, u khun u Zeruïa, u la ong ha u syiem, “Balei sha une u ’sewïap u tim ïa u syiem kynrad jong nga ? Shuh ngan leit dkhat ïa ka khlieh jong u.”
Hynrei u syiem u la ong ha u, “Sa lei ïa nga bad ïa phi ko khun u Zeruïa ? Lada u tim namarba u Trai U la phah ïa u ban tim ïa u Dabid, mano ba dei ban kylli, ‘Balei phi la leh kumta ?’ ”

Te u Dabid u la ong ha u Abishai bad ha ki nongbud jong u baroh, “Ha peit seh, u khun jong nga hi u wad ïa ka jingim jong nga, katno lei lei une u Benjamin ! Ieh ïa u, ieh un tim, namar u Trai U la phah ïa u.
Lehse u Trai Un peit isynei ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga, bad Un sa siew kylliang ïa nga da ka jingbha na ka bynta ka jingshah tim mynta ka sngi.”
Kumta u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la ïaleit la ka lynti, katba u Shimei pat de u la leit na kjat lum mar pyrshah jong u. Une u la tim katba u ïaid, bad u la kawang da ki maw bad ka khyndew.
Te u syiem bad ki paid baroh kiba ïadon bad u ki la thait haba ki la poi ha ka Jordan; kumta u la shong pynjah thait ïa lade.
Te u Absalom ryngkat bad ki paidbah Israel baroh ki la wan sha Jerusalem; u Ahithophel u la don bad u.
Haba u Hushai nong Arkhi, u lok u Dabid, u la wan sha u Absalom, u la ai khublei ïa u Absalom, “To u syiem un im slem ! To u syiem un im slem!”
Hangta u Absalom u la ong ha u Hushai, “Hato da kumne pleng ka jingieid jong phi ïa la u lok ? Balei phim shym leit bad u lok jong phi ?”
U Hushai u la jubab ïa u Absalom, “Em, ïa uta ïa uba U Trai bad une u paidbah bad ki rangbah Israel baroh ki la jied, u jong uta nga ruh ngan long, bad ngan ïaineh bad uta.
Kumba nga la shakri ïa u kpa jong phi, kumta ngan shakri ïa phi. Ïano keiñ nga dei ban shakri, lait tang ïa u khun jong u ?”
Te u Absalom u la ong ha u Ahithophel, “Ha ong ma phi aïu ngi dei ban leh ?”

U Ahithophel u la ong ha u Absalom, “Khie leit bad ki tnga kliar u kpa jong phi, ïa kiba u la ieh noh ban ap ïa ka ïing; haba ki Israel baroh kin sa tip ba phi la pynisih ïa lade ha u kpa jong phi, baroh kiba ïashah bad phi kin sa nangkhlaiñ”.
Kumta ki la sieh kawei ka ïing jaiñ na ka bynta u Absalom halor tnum ïing, kumta u Absalom u la leit sha ki tnga kliar u kpa jong u haba ïohi ki Israel baroh.
Ha kito ki por ïa kano kano ka jingai buit u Ahithophel la ñiew kumba dei ka ktien u Blei. Kumta keiñ ïa ka jingai buit u Ahithophel la ñiew kor da u Dabid bad da u Absalom ruh.
Nalor nangta u Ahithophel u la ong ha u Absalom, “Shuh ngan jied khat-ar hajar ngut ki briew, bad ngan leit beh nadien ïa u Dabid mynta ka miet.
Ngan lap ïa u haba u la thait bad u la tlot ka mynsiem, bad ngan sa pynher ïap her im ïa u. Hangta ki paid baroh kiba ïadon bad u kin sa phet krad bad ngan sa pom tang ïa u syiem.
Kumta ngan sa ïalam ïa ki paid baroh sha phi la kum ïa ka tnga kaba wan phai sha la u tnga. Phi wad ïa ka jingim jong uwei u briew, bad baroh u paid un sa suk sa saiñ.”
Kata ka jingai buit ka la pynsngewbha ïa u Absalom bad ïa ki tymmen ki san Israel baroh.
Hadien kata u Absalom u la khot ïa u Hushai, “Khot sa ïa u Hushai nong Arkhi, bad shuh ngin sngap sa aïu u ong.”
Ynda u Hushai u la wan sha u Absalom, u Absalom u la ong ha u, “U Ahithophel u la lah kren kumto, hato ngin leh kumba u la ai buit ? Lada ym dei, kren sa ma phi.”
Te u Hushai u la ong ha u Absalom, “Ha kane ka kynti ka jingai buit u Ahithophel kam long kaba sngewdei.”

Nangta u Hushai u la ong, “Phi tip, ba u kpa jong phi bad ki briew jong u ki long ki ’riewïaleh, bad haba la pyndom ïa ki kin leh kum ka dngiem kaba la shah tuh khun ha lum. Nalor kata, u kpa jong phi u long uba tbit ha ka thma, un ym sahmiet satia bad ki paidbah.

Wat mynta u rieh ha ka krem aïu re aïu, ne ha kano kano ka jaka. Haba tang shu don ba kyllon ha ka jingïaleh banyngkong, kat uba ïohsngew ïa kata un ong, ‘La shah pynïap bun ki briew kiba bud ïa u Absalom.’

Hangta wat u briew uba ïaw mynsiem, uba don ka dohnud kum ka jong u sing, un sa her mynsiem khait. Ki Israel baroh ki tip ba u kpa jong phi u long u briew u bakhlaiñ bor bad ba ki paid baroh kiba don bad u ki long ma ki ruh ki ’riewdohsnieh.
Ka buit jong nga ka long ba phin lum ïa ki paid Israel baroh bad phi naduh Dan haduh Beersheba, la kat u shyiap haruh duriaw ha ka jingbun paid, bad nangta ïalam hi ma phi sha ka thma.
Kumta ngin sa lap ïa u ha ka jaka aïu re kaba u dei ban don, bad ngin sa hiar halor jong u kum ka umjer kaba hap ha khyndew. Ma u pat bad ki briew baroh kiba don bad u, uwei ruh un ym sah.
Lada u leit phet sha kano kano ka shnong, ki Israel baroh kin wan rah ki tyllai sha kata ka shnong, bad ngin tan ïa ka shaduh them, haduh ba yn ym sah shuh wat uwei u maw pyllon rit hangta.”

Te u Absalom bad ki rangbah Israel baroh ki la ong, “Ka jingai buit u Hushai nong Arkhi ka kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Ahithophel.” Dei u Trai Uba la pynïaid ban rem ka jingai buit babha jong u Ahithophel, khnang ban wanlam ka jingjot ïa u Absalom.
Te u Hushai u la ong ha u Zadok bad u Abiathar, ki lyngdoh, “U Ahithophel u la ai buit da kumne ïa u Absalom bad ki tymmen ki san Israel baroh, nga pat nga la ai buit da kumwei pat.
Mynta phah briew bak bak ban ïathuh ïa u Dabid, ‘Wat sah miet hajan ki madan wah jong ka ri kynjah, hynrei katba lah jam noh sha shiliang, ïoh u syiem bad ki paid kiba don bad u kin shah nguid !’ ”

Ha kata ka por u Jonathan bad u Ahimaaz ki dang ïa-ap ha Enrogel; kawei ka shakri pat kan leit ïathuh ïa ki, ba ki dei ban leit pyntip ïa u syiem Dabid. Ym dei ban don ba ïohi ba ki rung hapoh shnong.

Hynrei uwei u khynnah samla u la ïohi ïa ki bad u la leit ïathuh ha u Absalom, kumta kita baroh ar ngut ki la phet bran bran bad ki la poi sha ïing uwei u briew ha Bahurim uba don ka pukri ha phyllaw; te ki la leit rieh hapoh hangta.
Ka trai ïing ka la shim kawei ka jingsiang bad ka la siang halor kata ka pukri, nangta ka la thad da u kew ba la tylliat halor kata, kumta ym don ba ithuh shuh ïa ka.

Haba ki nongbud u Absalom ki la poi sha ïing kata ka briew, ki la ong, “Haei u Ahimaaz bad u Jonathan ?” Kata ka kynthei ka la ïathuh ïa ki, “Ki la leit sha shiliang ka wah rit.” Kumta ki la leit wad ïa ki bad kim shym shem satia ïa ki, nangta ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem.

Ynda ki la leit, kita ki briew ki la mih na ka pukri bad ki la leit ïathuh ïa u syiem Dabid. Ki la ong, “Ïeng, leit noh bak bak sha shiliang ka wah, namar u Ahithophel u la lah ai buit ban leh kumta kumta.”
Te u Dabid u la ïeng lang bad ki paid baroh kiba don bad u, bad ki la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan. Ynda kynjat shai mynstep ym shym don shuh wat uwei ubym shym leit sha shiliang ka Jordan.

Haba u Ahithophel u la ïohi ba ïa ka jingai buit jong u ym shym bud, u la teh jin ïa la ka kada, bad u la leit noh sha la ïing ha shnong lajong. Ynda u la pynbeit ïa la ka ïing ka sem, u la leit phasi ïa lade bad u la ïap, nangta la tep ïa u ha ka jyntep u kpa jong u.
Te u Dabid u la poi sha Mahanaim. U Absalom pat de u la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ki paid Israel baroh.

U Absalom u la thung rangbah pyrton ïa u Amasa ha ka jaka u Joab. U Amasa u la long u khun jong uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Ithra, u jait Ishmael, uba la poikha ïa ka Abigail, ka khun u Nahash, ka para ka Zeruïa, ka kmie u Joab.
Ki Israel bad u Absalom ki la sher dara ha ka ri Gilead.
Haba u Dabid u la poi ha Mahanaim, u Shobi, u khun u Nahash na Rabba jong ki Ammon, u Makhir, u khun u Ammiel na Lodebar, bad u Barzillai, u nong Gilead na Rogelim,
ki la wan rah ki jynthiah, ki dabor, ki khiew khyndew, u kew, u barli, u moida, u shira, ki phresbin bad u dai,

nangta ka ngap, ka doi, ki langbrot, bad ka panir na ki jynri na ka bynta u Dabid bad ki paid kiba bad u ban bam. Ki la ong, “Katne ki paid ki la ïathngan, ki la ïathait bad ki la ïasliang ha ka ri kynjah.”
Te u Dabid u la lum lang ïa ki pyrton baroh kiba don bad u, bad u la thung ïa ki rangbah shihajar bad shispah.

Nangta u Dabid u la phah ïa ki pyrton shibynta na ki lai bynta hapoh ka jingïalam u Joab, shi bynta hapoh ka jingïalam u Abishai khun u Zeruïa, u para u Joab, bad shi bynta hapoh ka jingïalam u Ittai nong Gitt. Te u syiem u la ong ha la ki pyrton, “Nga ruh ngan leit lang bad phi.”

Hynrei ki briew ki la ong, “Phim dei ban leit. Namar lada ngi phet, kin ym salia ïa ngi. Lada shiteng na ngi ngi ïap, kin ym salia shaphang jong ngi. Hynrei phi shongdor kum shiphew hajar na ngi. Namarkata ka bha ba phi shu phah jingïarap ïa ngi na shnong.”
U syiem u la ong ha ki, “Kat kaba phi ibit ngan leh.” Kumta u syiem u la ïeng harud ka khyrdop katba ki pyrton baroh ki ïaïaid shaphrang da ki spah bad hajar.

U syiem u la ia hukum ïa u Joab, u Abishai bad u Ittai, “Leh jem ïa u samla Absalom, namar jong nga.” Ki paid Israel baroh ki la ïohsngew haba u syiem u ai hukum ïa ki rangbah pyrton baroh shaphang u Absalom.
Kumta ki pyrton ki la leit sha jaka ïaleh pyrshah ki Israel, bad ïa ka thma la ïaleh ha ka khlaw Ephraim.
Ki Israel ki la shah rem ha ki nongbud u Dabid, bad ka jingpynïap ha kata ka sngi ka la long ka bakhraw, haduh arphew hajar ngut ki briew.
Ka thma ka la phriang kylleng sawdong ka ri, bad dei ka khlaw, ym ka waitlam, kaba la bam briew kham bun ha kata ka sngi.

La jia ryngkhat ba u Absalom u la ïakynduh ïa ki nongbud u Dabid. U Absalom u la shong halor u khashor bad uta u khashor u la leit phrung ha ki tnat ki basañium jong u dieng sning u baheh, kumta u ’ñiuhkhlieh jong u u la ngat trait ha uta u dieng sning. U la sdien hapdeng ka suiñ bneng bad ka khyndew, katba u khashor, uba u la shong, u la phet la ka phet.
Uwei u briew u la ïohi ïa kane, bad u la leit ïathuh ha u Joab ba u la ïohi ïa u Absalom ba u sdien ha u dieng sning.
U Joab u la kylli ïa uta uba wan ïathuh ïa u, “Aïu, me da ïohi ïa u? Balei mem shym pom ïa u hangta ba un hap ha khyndew ? Ngan jin da la ai ïa me shiphew lyngkhot ka rupa bad uwei u panpoh.”

Hynrei uta u briew u la ong ha u Joab, “Wat lada nga ïoh shihajar lyngkhot ka rupa ha ka kti jong nga, ngan ym ktah kti ïa u khun u syiem. Nga hi nga la ïohsngew ba u syiem u la ai hukum ïa phi, ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Ittai, ‘Namar jong nga, to ïada ïa u samla Absalom.’
Nalor kata, lada nga la pynïap ïa u (bad ym lah hi ruh ban buhrieh na u syiem), phi hi phin jin da la ieh noh noh ïa nga.”
U Joab u la ong, “Ngan ym pynlut kai ka por kumne bad me” Te u la shim lai tylli ki nar sum ha ka kti, bad u la tynrah ïa ki ha ka dohnud u Absalom, katba u dang im ha uta u dieng sning.
Nangta shiphew ngut ki samla, ki nongkieng tiar ïapom u Joab, ki la ker tawiar ïa u Absalom, ki la pom ïa u haban da ïap.
Hadien kata u Joab u la put ïa ka turoi bad ki pyrton ki la wan phai na kaba beh ïa ki Israel, namarba u Joab u la pynsangeh ïa ki.

Ki la shim ïa u Absalom, ki la bret ïa u ha kawei ka thliew ka baheh ha khlaw, bad ki la kynton halor jong u shithup bah u maw; katba ki paid Israel baroh ki la her ïap sha la ka jong ka jong ka ïing jaiñ.

U Absalom haba u dang im u la tei hi na ka bynta ïa lade uwei u mot ha ka Them u Syiem, namar u ong, “Ngam don khun shynrang ban sah jingkynmaw ïa nga.” U la ai kyrteng ha lade ïa uta u mot, bad la khot u mot u Absalom haduh kane ka sngi.
Te u Ahimaaz, khun u Zadok, u la ong, “Shuh ngan mareh ma nga ban rah khubor sha u syiem ba u Trai U la pyllait ïa u na ka bor ki nongshun jong u.”
Te u Joab u la ong ha u, “Phim dei ban rah khubor ei ei mynta ka sngi; phi lah ban leit rah ha kawei pat ka sngi. Mynta ka sngi phim dei ban leit rah khubor namarba u khun u syiem u la ïap.”
Kumta u Joab u la ong ha uwei u Kushi, “Khie leit ïathuh ma me ha u syiem kat kaba me la ïohi.” Uta u Kushi u la nguh ïa la ka khlieh ha u Joab, bad u la mareh.
